tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ gzhan bskul gyi ngor bris pa'i smon lam gyi skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa nor bu'i mdzod khang bzhugs so// 2)ma lus 'gro lam ma ltar brtse ba can// thar med sems can thar pa'i lam la 'god// skyabs kyi dam pa skyabs mchog spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje'i bdag pos thugs kyi brtser dgongs la// dus mthar skyes pa'i dus ngan sems can rnams// dam pa'i chos la dam par mi 'dzin par// log pa'i las spyod log pa'i las zhugs pa'i// ma rig 'gro la ma g.yel thugs rjes bzung*// bde chen zhing du bde la bkod du gsol/ de yang bdag lta bu ni thos bsam bsgom pa'i yon tan gyis dben cing*/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi dgongs don phyogs tsam yang ma 'khrol ba'i rmongs 3) pa blo dman bdag 'dras 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum bgyis pa'i nus pa ni cha tsam yang ga la mchis shing*/ khyad par du yang bde legs smon lam 'grub pa la ngag gi bden tshig grub pa zhig med par smon lam byed pa'i gang zag gi skal bar ldan pa dka' mod kyi/ 'on kyang lhag bsam dag pas kun nas blangs na ji ltar smon bzhin 'grub par yang gsungs ste/ ji skad du/ rang 'dod zhen ngan spangs nas ni// lhag bsam dge bas gzhan don du// smon lam gang dang gang btab pa// de 'bad mi dgos myur 'grub 'gyur/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ khyad par rang la mos 'dun du byed pa'i skyes bu dag gis nan gyis bskul ba'i ngo ma chog par gang dran ci 'thon du smras pa'i tshig rnams yi ger bkod rung gzhan don du 'gyur bar dka' 4) mod ste/ 'on kyang gal te snyigs ma'i dus kyi gang zag rang dang 'dra ba'i blo dman re zhig la phan pa'ang srid snyam nas/ yul dus so sor smras pa rnams rim pa bzhin du bri bar bya'o// dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas// rtsa gsum lha dang rig 'dzin grub pa'i tshogs// chos srung rgya mtsho dkar phyogs skyong rnams kyis// rnam dag smon lam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i phan bde'i rgyu gcig pu// dge legs yon tan mtha' dag 'byung ba'i gzhi// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen dri med nyid// phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig

/ji snyed sems can khams rnams ma lus par// de snyed rgyal ba'i bstan pas yongs khyab cing*// rang gi blo dang mos khams ji bzhin pa'i// zab rgyas chos la 'gro kun spyod gyur cig /theg pa'i mthar thug bla med yang dag don// lta ba'i yang rtse rmad byung rdzogs pa che// bstan pa'i snying po 'od gsal rdo rje'i theg /dar zhing rgyas la yun ring gnas 5)gyur cig /bslab gsum rnam dag yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa'i// bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa chen yongs khyab cing*// thos bsam bsgom pa'i nyi zla 'bum shar bas// bstan pa'i sgron me phyogs kun gsal gyur cig /snang grags lha sngags snod bcud rgyal ba'i zhing*// de nyid rig pa'i klong du ro gcig pa'i// stong gsal dbyer med kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong*// ka dag dbyings su 'gro kun grol gyur cig /dkon mchog bden pa'i phyin rlabs rmad byung dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag bden pa'i mthus// smon lam thams cad bgegs med 'grub pa dang*/ rgyal bstan yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog/ ces pa 'di ni spo bo yid 'ong gi sa phyogs su bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i chos kyi rje o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi bkas/ bstan pa rgyas byed kyi smon lam zhig dgos zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ bdag karma rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal bas/ smin grol bskyed rdzogs gling nas phul ba'o// 6)shākya'i dge slong dge 'dun nyi ma grogs bcas kun// mi mthun nyer 'tshe 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi zhing*// chos dang mthun pa'i 'dod don ma lus 'grub gyur nas// myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa thob par shog ces pa'i sho lo ka 'di ni/ mdo khams tsha ba sgang nas dge ldan pa'i dge slob 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor bris pa'o// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma dang*// de nyid lhag pa'i lhar bzhengs yi dam lha// phrin las bsgrub mdzad mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// phyogs dus rgyal ba ma lus dgongs su gsol// bdag gis thog mtha' med nas da lta'i bar// dge ba'i las bsags gyur pa ci mchis pa// de dag rnams kyi mthu dang nus pa yis// bden tshig smon lam 'di dag 'grub gyur cig

/deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// dal 'byor mir skyes chos ldan dbang po tshang*// bstan pa'i sgor zhugs bla mas rjes su bzung*// rdo rje theg pa'i 7)zab don bsgom par shog /tshul min khe grags lo 'dod kun spong zhing*// rtse gcig bsgrub pa'i snying po lhur blangs te// rang don ka dag zad sar 'khyol byas nas// gzhan don phrin las rlabs chen 'grub par shog /rje btsun bla ma dam pa khyed dang ni// skye dang tshe rabs kun tu mi 'bral zhing*// dam tshig nyes ltung dri mas ma gos par// thugs rje byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug par shog /gzhan yang tshe 'dir lus ngag yid gsum la// nad gdon nyer 'tshe bar chad kun zhi zhing*// bsam don chos ldan yid bzhin 'grub gyur nas// myur du gdod ma'i sa der phyin par shog ces pa 'di ni rang gi nye gnas bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyi bskul ngor bkod pa'o// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma yis// byin rlabs mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung bskyed nas*// dad ldan mos pa'i 8)bu la thugs rjes gzigs// dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs thams cad du// mi khoms gnas spangs chos ldan yul du skyes// dam pas rjes bzung zab mo'i chos la spyod// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// tshe ring nad med longs spyod phun sum tshogs// 'gal rkyen kun zhi bsam don chos bzhin 'grub*// myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob nas kyang*// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dpal gyur cig ces pa 'di ni/ kong yul shing lo'i tshal gyi thad gu ru rin po ches bdud srin ma rungs pa btul ba'i sa phyogs thil zhes bya ba nas/ dad 'byor ldan pa'i sbyin bdag nā tha'i ming can la sbyin pa'o/ phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus dang*// skyabs kun gcig bsdus pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal// bdag sogs 'gro la thugs rjes brtser dgongs nas// bsam pa'i don kun 'bad med 'grub pa dang*// chos dang bkra shis bde legs rab 'phel zhing*// myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob gyur cig/

ces pa ni 9) chos kyi rje pad+ma blo gros kyigrwa pa 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor mtshams mal nas so// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje dang*// dgongs brda snyan rgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// kun bzang rig 'dzin bsam don chos bzhin 'grub// lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol gyur cig /zhi khro rab 'byams rnams kyi thugs rje dang*// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun 'grub cing*// dgos 'dod ma lus yid bzhin 'byung gyur cig /ma tshogs mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs rje dang*// bstan bsrung chos skyong rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// 'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus kun zhi zhing*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas gyur cig /rtsa gsum lha tshogs bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// bslu med rten 'brel zab mo'i nus mthu dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i bden stobs kyis// smon lam gang btab deng 'dir 'grub 10)par shog/ ces gnas chen gyi sgrub grwa nas dad ldan kun bzang rig 'dzin la'o// ༈ chos dbyings rab 'byams klong yangs zhing khams nas /dus gsum rgyal dang nyan thos rang rgyal tshogs// yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams rgya mtshor bcas// smon lam bden tshig 'grub pa'i dpang mdzod cig /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sdug bsngal rba rlabs can// yang yang 'khor zhing rtag tu mnar ba las// thar gling bde chen zhing du bder phyin nas// 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// dal 'byor lus thob dam pa'i chos dang mjal// dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su bzung*// zab mo'i gdams pa nyams su len par shog /lus ngag yid gsum chos dang mthun pa yi// bsam pa'i don kun 'bad med 'grub pa dang*// 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe ma lus kun zhi nas// myur du byang chub mchog la reg par shog

/gnas skabs tshe 11)'dir nad gdon bar chad sogs// mi mthun gnod pa thams cad rab zhi zhing*// mnga' thang chos srid dpal 'byor longs spyod rnams// yar zla ltar 'phel bde legs kun 'byung shog /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje dang*// yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi nus mthu yis// bsam don kun 'grub 'dod dgu phun tshogs pa'i// bkra shis rab 'byams phyogs mthar khyab gyur cig ces pa 'di ni gnod mdzes mkhar gyi yul ljongs kyi bdag mo bkra shis dbang mos bskul ngor bris pa'o// phyogs dus rgyal dang de sras nyan thos tshogs// dgongs brda snyan rgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can srung mar bcas// bden tshig smon lam 'grub pa'i dpang mdzod cig /deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar// dal 'byor lus thob sangs rgyas kun dang mjal// dam pas rjes bzung zab don nyams su blangs// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ 12)/gnas skabs tshe 'dir lus ngag yid gsum la// mi mthun nyer 'tshe 'gal rkyen kun zhi nas// yid la bsam pa'i don kun chos bzhin 'grub// myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog thob shog/ ces pa ni 'tsho mdzad karma 'gro phan la'o// stong nyid mkha' la thugs rje'i 'od stong 'phro// tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam sgyu mar rig /byams dang snying rjes 'gro la brtse ba can// drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// snyigs dus 'gro ba'i don la brtser dgongs nas// snga 'gyur snying po'i bstan pa spel slad du// bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan pa dang*// chos 'khor rgyun mi chad par bskor du gsol// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// srid pa'i 'ching ba'i 'dam las rab thar nas// khyod dang dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas par shog ༈ bslu med 13)kyi rgyal ba dkon mchog gsum// 'gro kun gyi skyabs gnas pad+ma 'byung*// mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong dam can tshogs// bdag smon lam 'grub pa'i dpang mdzod cig

/skal ldan gyi skyes mchog dam pa 'di// dus mthar thug byang chub ma thob par// skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du// rje pad+mas byin gyis brlab par shog /lus gsal stong bskyed rim ngang gnas shing*// de snang stong chu zla lta bur rtogs// gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po nyid// 'od gsal 'ja' lus su 'grub par shog /ngag rdo rje'i bzlas pa chu bo'i rgyun// dus rtag tu g.yel med bzlas byas shing*// de grags stong dbyer med brag cha ltar// brjod med kyi ngang du grol bar shog /yid 'khrul rtog gi 'byung khungs sems nyid 'di// bag chags kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar// bde sdug gi snang ba rang sar dag /dbyings rig dbyer med kyi don rtogs shog 14)/skal ldan gyi skyes mchog 'di nyid ni// bar chad kyi rkyen gyis ma khyer zhing*// 'gro don dang gdul bya'i sgo bye nas// sems can la phan pa mang 'grub shog /rig 'dzin gyi skyes mchog dam pa 'di// sku tshe dang phrin las mthar phyin zhing*// gnas skabs su 'gro don lhun grub nas// mthar thug tu mngon sangs rgyas par shog/ ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// skal ldan 'di yi lus ngag yid gsum la// sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs// snyen sgrub mthar phyin phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub// bskyed rdzogs brtan thob spangs rtogs mngon du gyur// gdod ma'i klong du gtan srid zin par shog /slar yang gang 'dul thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// 'gro blo'i mun sel re 'dod yid bzhin skongs// lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las mchog /'bad med 15)nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'byung bar shog/ ༈ rje dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dpal// mgon mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung*// khyed thugs rje nus pa'i dpung bskyed la// rgyud byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// skal ldan gyi skyes mchog ma ṇi'i mtshan// bsam bzhin du srid pa nyer bzhes nas// rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa rgya chen po// yar zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par shog

/gzhi ka dag rang gsal skye med kyi// don 'gyur med brtsan sa rab zin nas// lam bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mngon gyur te// dbyings gdod ma'i gtan srid zin par shog /bka' rgyud bla ma'i thugs rje nus mthu dang*// yi dam lha tshogs zhi khro'i rab 'byams kyis// skyes mchog dam pa 'gro don lhun grub ni// sku tshe brtan zhing phrin las rgyas gyur cig /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang dang*// rig 'dzin grub mchog skyes chen thams cad kyis/ 16)/'gro ba'i don du smon lam gang btab pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis 'grub gyur cig// rang rig stong gsal mkha' dbyings su// lhag bsam rab dkar sprin phung stibs// smon lam rnam dag char rgyun gyis// don gnyis 'bras bu smin byed cig /dgos zhes bka' yis bskul ba'i ngor// bya btang sprang po rgyal khams pas// smin grol bskyed rdzogs gling du bris// dge bas 'gro la phan 'grub shog /ces le mtshan gong 'og 'di dag rnams ni/ bla ma zla ba chos grags kyi skye mtha' rgyal sras 'gro don lhun grub ces pa'am/ mtshan gzhan du bla ma tshe ring nor bu zhes pa'i thugs bzhed skong phyir snga phyi so sor bris pa dag 'dir grigs chags su bkod pa'o// skal bzang sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba dgongs rgyud byin rlabs kyi// 'gro ba'i bla ma 'ja' tshon snying po ni// sku tshe brtan zhing phrin las rgyas gyur cig /bka' gter rgyud pa'i bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// grub mchog rig 'dzin brda rgyud byin rlabs kyis// 'gro ba'i bla ma= 17)sku tshe= gang zag snyan rgyud bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong byin rlabs nus mthu yis// 'gro ba'i bla ma= sku tshe= de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// 'gro ba'i mgon po 'ja' tshon snying po nyid/ bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan pa ru// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs su gsol/

zhes gter ston rig 'dzin chen po de nyid la gus pas phul ba'o// chos dbyings mkha' khyab rab 'byams zhing khams nas// byin rlabs mthu ldan bde gshegs rgyal ba'i tshogs// 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan pad 'byung la sogs kyis// thugs rje'i shugs bskyed 'chi med dngos grub stsol// theg pa'i yang bcud snga 'gyur snying po'i don// yang dag 'dzin pas don gnyis lhun grub pa// bstan pa'i gsal byed pad+ma blo gros mchog /mi 'gyur bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs brtan gsol/ 18)/gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha mthar legs son cing*// smin grol 'dod 'byung gter gyi dga' ston gyis// dad ldan gdul bya'i re 'dod skong ba'i phyir// mi 'gyur bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs brtan gsol// stong nyid khyab gdal spros bral mkha' dbyings su// 'gags med thugs rje'i nyi 'od phyogs bcur 'gyed// 'gro blo'i mun sel bstan pa'i sgron me ru// mi 'gyur bskal pa= de phyir gsol ba btab pa'i bden stobs dang*// phyogs dus rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i nus mthu yis// pad+ma'i rgyal tshab pad+ma blo gros nyid// sku tshe brtan zhing phrin las rgyas par shog/

ces pa 'di mdo khams kyi phyogs su bstan pa'i sgron me sbar bar mdzad pa'i chos kyi rje pad+ma blo gros kyi sku tshe'i bstan bzhugs su/ slob dpon rin po che dam chos pas thugs bsam rnamadag gis bskul bar mdzad pa la brten nas smin grol bskyed rdzogs gling du bkod pa'o// phyogs dus rgyal ba rab 'byams sras bcas dang*// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi 19)dam mkha' 'gror bcas// chos srung stobs ldan bden pa grub rnams kyis// smon lam 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// theg kun yang rtse bla med snying po'i bcud// chos kun mthar thug 'od gsal rdzogs pa che'i// don bzang legs par ston mdzad chos kyi rje// dpal ldan bla ma sku tshe brtan gyur cig /bstan pa'i yang snying snga 'gyur theg mchog 'di// rtog ge'i grub mthas brnyas pa'i dus ngan 'dir// yang zab a ti'i bstan pa spel slad du// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs gyur cig /rgyal kun gcig bsdus pad+ma thod phreng gi /gsung gi gsang ba zab mo'i thugs bcud rnams// dad ldan 'gro la ris med rtsol ba'i phyir// bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /de ltar gsol ba btabs pa'i bden stobs kyis// khyed zhabs bstan zhing chos kyi phrin las rgyas/ 20)/bdag dang ma rgan khams gsum 'gro ba kun// ka dag dbyings su khyed dang dbyer med shog ces pa 'di ni/ snga 'gyur 'od gsal snying po'i bstan pa spel bar mdzad pa'i chos kyi rje 'od gsal nam mkha' 'brug sgra'i zhabs drung du phul ba'o/ / phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthu stobs dpungs bskyed nas// bdag sogs rnams la byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// smon lam gegs med 'grub par mdzad du gsol// bdag gis 'khor 'das dus gsum bsags pa'i dge// byas dang byed 'gyur rjes su yi rangs sogs// rnam dkar dge tshogs ji snyed bskrun pa'i mthus// bstan dang 'gro la phan pa mang 'grub shog

/gnas skabs tshe 'dir lus ngag yid gsum la// nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad rab zhi zhing*// bsam don 'bad med chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs par shog /skye ba skye ba gzhan rnams thams cad du/ 21)/rin chen rin chen las lhag dal 'byor thob// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas sras bcas rjes bzung ste// chos dang chos kyi dpal la spyod par shog /'khor bar gnas kyang 'khor bas ma gos shing*// srid par spyod kyang srid pa'i 'ching grol te// lhag bsam dag pas lhag par gzhan don spyod// 'gro ba sgrol mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon du shog /shes bya'i gnas kun kun la rab mkhas shing*// ting 'dzin mchog bsgrub sgrub la rtag tu brtson// bdud las rab rgyal rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid nyid du bsgrub gyur cig ces pa 'di ni/ mi dbang karma bstan srung la'o// phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ bdag ni 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du// dal 'byor dam pa skyon med thob pa 22)dang*// dge ba'i bshes kyi rjes su 'dzin pa dang*// rdo rje theg pa'i chos la spyod nas kyang*// tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub la brtson par shog /'jig rten chos brgyad 'khrul phyir mi 'brang shing*// sdig pa'i grogs dang gtan du bral ba dang*// dad dang brtson grus shes rab phul byung pas// chos kyi gnad don tshul bzhin rtogs par shog /thos pa rgya mtsho ngom pa med pa dang*// bsam pa dge bas las min spong ba dang*// bsgom pa'i nyams rtogs rtsal gsum rdzogs pa yis// gzhan la'ang gdams pa rgya cher ston par shog /'gro ba'i mgon gyur mtshan ldan bla ma la// mnyes pa gsum gyi zhabs gtog mthar phyin te// dam tshig nyes ltung dri mas ma gos shing*// 'bral med byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug par shog /rang don btsan sa legs par zin nas kyang*// lus srog ltos med ngal ba khyad bsad de// chos

23)dang zang zing mi 'jigs sbyin pa yis// 'gro drug pha ma bde la 'god par shog /sems can sdug bsngal rgya mtsho ma zad bar// bdag gi mdzad phrin rgya mtsho dpag med kyis// 'gro la phan pa rgya mtsho 'byung ba yi// rnam dag smon lam rgya mtsho 'grub gyur cig /phyogs bcu mtha' yas zhing khams kun bzhugs pa'i// rgyal ba mtha' yas sras bcas kun gyis ni// smon lam mtha' yas gang dag ci mchis pa'i// dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun grol shog ces pa 'di ni o rgyan sbyin pa la'o// bden pa'i don ston rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// bden gnyis zung 'jug lung rtogs dam pa'i chos// bden 'dzin 'khrul snang chos skur grol mdzad pa// bden tshig grub rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// dal 'byor phun tshogs 24)rdo rje'i theg dang mjal// dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pas rab zin nas// 'khrul med lam la yang dag 'jug par shog /bslu byed 'jig rten sgyu ma'i mig 'phrul la// dug can zas ltar ring nas rgyab phyogs te// zab don snying po'i don mchog spyod pa la// bkres pas zas mthong bzhin du 'jug par shog /me 'dag lta bu'i log 'tsho'i dkor zas dang*// bdag 'dzin skyed byed snyan grags 'du 'dzi dang*// dge sbyor rlag byed 'jig rten chos brgyad kun// rgyang du bsrings nas thar pa bsgrub par shog /'ga' zhig bdag la gnod pa'i sems kyis su// khro zhing dmod dang brdeg 'tshog gsod kyang rung*// sdang sems khro 'khrug 'khon 'dzin rab spangs te// gnod lan byang sems chos kyi 'jal bar shog /tshe 'di don du gnyer ba las byung ba'i// bde ba'i mtsho brdol skyid pa'i nyi 25)shar kyang*// dgos med zhen log gting nas skyes pa yis// chos phyir dka' spyad ri khrod 'grim par shog /dben pa'i gnas su 'du 'dzi kun spangs te// rang sems dpang gtsugs dkon mchog mi 'khrel ba'i// yengs med dge sbyor nyin mtshan dus 'da' zhing*// rang rgyud dam pa'i chos kyis thul bar shog

/gal te rnam rtog 'khrul phyir 'brang gyur kyang*// skad cig de la dran rig rtsis zin te// sgom med yengs med brjod bral gnas lugs don// rang shar rang grol ka dag mngon gyur shog /rang babs gnas tshe spros bral chos kyi sku// 'gags med rang mdangs lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs 'phro yang shar grol sprul sku'i ngang*// cir shar sku gsum dbyer med rtogs par shog /ngo bo stong pa rdzogs rim mtshan ma bral// rang bzhin gsal ba bskyed rim yi dam lha// zung 'jug dbyer med 26)bzang ngan blang dor bral// chos nyid rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lhun grub shog /mnyam bzhag rjes thos spang blangs las 'das kyang*// 'gags med rtsal snang 'phro 'du'i rol pa kun// dag snang mos gus snying rjer rang shar nas// rang gzhan don kun 'bad med 'byung bar shog /gal te bar do'i snang ba 'char gyur kyang*// khregs chod thod rgal zab gnad snying po kun// gcig car dran pas rang snang ngo shes te// yin lugs ji bzhin rtogs nas grol bar shog /bdag nyid mthong thos reg pa'i 'gro ba kun// bdag 'dzin 'ching ba'i zhags pa rab grol te// bdag med yang dag gnas lugs rtogs nas kyang*// bdag gzhan dbyer med chos skur grol bar shog /sangs rgyas zhing khams rgya mtsho mtha' yas par// sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul rgya mtsho dpag med ltar// sangs rgyas mdzad pa rgya mtsho bdag 'grub shog /byang chub sems kyis 'gro ba sgrol mdzad pa'i// byang sems rnams kyis 'gro 27)la brtser dgongs te// byang chub spyod pa tshad med spyad pa bzhin// byang sems spyod la bdag kyang 'jug par shog /nam mkhas gar khyab nam mkha' gnas kyi bar// 'khor ba yang yang 'khor ba'i 'gro ba rnams// bla med go 'phang bla na med pa rung*// 'dren pa'i ded dpon 'dren mchog bdag gyur cig ces rnal 'byor pa chos 'phel bzang po la'o//

phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pas// thugs rje nus pa'i dpung chen rab bskyod nas// bdag gi smon lam 'di dag 'grub pa yi// re 'dod yid bzhin skong bar mdzad du gsol// deng nas bzung ste skye ba thams cad du// mi khom gnas spangs dal 'byor rin chen thob// dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog gis rjes bzung ste// smin grol zab mo'i don la spyod par shog /thos pas chos kun sgro 'dogs legs chod cing*// bsam pas 28)ma nor don la 'jug pa dang*// bsgom pas nyams rtogs 'bras bu smin pa yis// rang don btsan sa legs par zin par shog /ji srid sems can rgya mtsho gnas kyi bar// de srid rnam 'phrul rgya mtsho 'gyed nus shing*// sangs rgyas phrin las rgya mtsho bdag 'grub pas// mtha' yas 'gro phan rgya mtsho mthar phyin shog /gnas skabs mthar thug 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen kun dang mi 'bral chos spyad de// rang gzhan don kun lhun gyis grub pa yi// go 'phang mchog la myur du reg par shog ces pa 'di ni chos kyi rgyal po rim par byon pa'i gdung rigs las 'khrungs shing lugs gnyis kyi dpal 'byor ldan pa'i lha'i btsun ma karma tshe ring bzang mo'i bkas bskul ba'i ngor/ 'khas grub ye bzang brtse ba sogs skyes chen mang po'i bzhugs gnas su gyur pa/ dpal rtse thang gi chos grwa chen po'i yang dben bsam gtan gling du bris pa'o// phyogs bcu dus gsum 29)rgyal ba ma lus pas// snyigs dus 'gro ba 'dren par bsngags pa'i mchog /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i sgron me 'jig rten mig /gzhan phan rdo rje bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// tha snyad shes bya'i gnas nas nyer bzung ste// sangs rgyas lag bcangs zab don mthar thug bar// chos kyi 'byung gnas khyed las gzhan med na// de slad bstan 'gro'i don dgongs zhabs brtan gsol// dkon mchog bden pa'i byin rlabs rmad byung dang*// rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs rje'i nus stobs kyis// 'dren mchog dpal mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// sku tshe brtan zhing 'phrin las rgyas pa yis// gsol btab don ldan 'grub par mdzad du gsol//

ces pa 'di ni/ bdag cag gi 'dren pa mtshungs bral skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang phyug ngag dbang gzhan phan rdo rje'i drung du phul ba'o// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ rgyal gsung 30)rab 'byams chos kyi chu gter las// legs byung theg pa'i bang rim mngon mtho'i rtser// yang gsang rdzogs chen rnam rgyal khang bzang la// dbang bskur dpal ldan bla ma zhabs brtan gsol// sna tshogs gzhung lugs du ma'i chu bo kun// ma lus gcig tu gzhol ba'i chu gter mchog /zab yangs gting mtha' bral ba'i klong chen po// rdzogs chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag zhabs brtan gsol// dus ring 'bad pa drag pos bslab sbyangs pa'i// mkhas par grags pa zla bral mchog rnams kyang*// khyed gsung zab mo'i chos sgras spobs bral mdzad// smra ba'i nyi ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// 'jig rten chos brgyad rnyed dang grags 'dod kyi// dri ma rdul cha tsam gyis ma gos shing*// zab don sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa'i u dum war// dad ldan rkang drug tshim mdzad zhabs brtan gsol// snyigs 31)dus mun gling 'khyams pa'i 'gro rnams la// bshes gnyen rgyu skar gzhan gyis snang byed pa'i// nus bral de slad rdzogs chen 'od stong can// khyod ni 'gro blo'i mun sel bskal brgyar bzhugs// snga 'gyur 'od gsal snying po'i nyi ma 'di// log rtog grub mtha' ngan pas sgribs nye shing*// ma rgan 'gro 'di log lam 'khyams pa la// mgon mdzad dam pa khyed zhabs rab brtan gsol// rtsa rgyud bla ma rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// gcig bsdus rgyal dbang pad+ma tshe yi bdag /bslu med chos srung stobs ldan tshogs bcas kyis// smon lam btab 'di 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ ces pa 'di yang chos rje rdzogs chen pa nam mkha' 'brug sgra'i brtan bzhugs su/ rje de nyid kyi grwa slob rnams kyis bskul ngor phul ba'o// rnam pa kun tu 'gro la phan bzhed pa'i// rgyal ba spyan ras gzigs sogs 'phags mchog dang*// bla ma

32)sangs rgyas dkon mchog dkyil 'khor lha// rnam 'dren mchog rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis thog mtha' med nas da lta'i bar// byas dang byed 'gyur byed la yi rangs pa'i// dge tshogs ci mchis mkha' mnyam 'gro kun la// lhag bsam dag pas yongs su bsngo bar gyi// 'khor ba rgya mtsho ji srid gnas kyi bar// bdag gi rnam 'phrul bkod pa mtha' yas pas// phan pa mchog dang bde ba bla med pa'i// byang chub lam la 'god pa'i nus ldan shog /dal 'byor rin chen thob dka' rnyed bzhin du// rang gis rang bslu stong zad mi byed par// 'khor ba'i gdos thag chod pa'i blo ldan zhing*// ma nor gtan srid zin la 'bad par shog /rnyed bkur grags pa don gnyer bla ma dang*// 'phrad tshad sdig la sbyor ba'i grogs ngan dang*// spyod tshad yon tan 'grib pa'i dkor zas sogs// lam gyi 'gal rkyen rnams dang 33) mi 'phrad shog /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i bshes gnyen dang*// 'grogs bzhin yon tan 'go ba'i grogs mchog dang*// dge sbyor gong du 'phel ba'i mthun rkyen te// thams cad rtsol med shugs las 'byung bar shog /snying po med cing las ngan gsog byed pa'i// ltar snang mdzes pas bslu byed 'khor ba'i chos// rnyed bkur grags sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi// dri ma rdul cha tsam yang bral bar shog /dkar gsal gangs ri'i ngogs dang g.ya' ri'i 'gul// lhung lhung snyan par sgrog pa'i chu klung 'gram// rab mdzes spang ri'i rtse dang nags kyi khrod// mi med dben pa'i ri khrod 'grim par shog /cong cong bya tshogs snyan pa'i glu len cing*// lhug lhug rtsed 'jo bde ba'i ri dwags bcas// zir zir bung ba lding ba'i ri khrod du// gcig pur bsam gtan bsgom la spro bar shog /shes shes rnam 34)grangs mang po'i blo sna dang*// byas byas don go med pa'i sdug yus dang*// thob thob rgyud la ma 'khel nga rgyal sogs// spangs nas tshe 'di sgrub pa mnyam par shog

/rang nyid mtho ris bde ba 'dod pa'am// gcig pu zhi ba'i byang chub gnyer ba'i blo// ma yin gzhan don kho na'i ched nyid du// bla med byang chub bsgrub la brtson par shog /khreg chod gzhi thog gtan la phebs pa dang*// thod rgal sku dang zhing khams bcud du smin// gdengs gnyis sdod pa gsum dang thos pa gsum// ma lus mngon gyur chos skur grol bar shog /rtog med chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin// rtsal mdangs gzugs sku gnyis sogs rnam rol 'phrul// du mas 'gro ba ma lus sgrol ba yi// phrin las rgyal ba kun las lhag par shog ces pa ni/ gtsang gi lha btsun 'phrin las gsang sngags 'dzin pas bskul ngor bris pa'o// swa sti sid+dhi/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i smon 35)lam mthu stobs dang*// 'khor 'das lam gsum dge ba'i 'bras gang gi// bden mthus skye ba 'di dang skye gzhan du// rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub la brtson par shog /phar phyin drug dang chos spyod rnam pa bcu// dge ba bcu dang thun mong dge tshogs dag /rang don gcig pu'i blo spangs gzhan gyi don// dmigs nas brtson pas thar pa bsgrub par shog /gsang ba'i yang gsang rdo rje theg pa'i lam// dbang gi rgyud smin grol byed bskyed dang rdzogs// nyams su blangs nas tshe gcig 'od kyi sku// mngon du gyur nas gzhan phan dpag yas shog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mdzad phrin dpag med dang*// rgyal sras byang sems 'gro phan nus stobs dang*// grub mchog rnams kyi nyams rtogs mthar phyin rtsal// yon tan ma lus bdag gis deng 'grub shog /chos dbyings nam mkha' ji srid gnas zhing kun// phrin las nam 36)mkha' khyab pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis// rigs drug nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams// skye med nam mkha' lta bur grol bar shog

ces pa 'di ni bla ma brtson 'grus la'o// rtsa rgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// thugs rje nus pa'i rtsal chen rmad byung bas// yid kyi re ba yongs su 'grub pa dang*// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'dren pa'i nus stobs mchog /rgyal kun mdzad phrin mthu rtsal mnyam par shog ces dge slong legs pa la'o// swa sti/ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// rtsa rgyud bla ma yid dam chos srung tshogs// lha dang drang srong bden pa 'grub kun gyis// bdag gis smon lam 'grub par mdzad du gsol// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas// byas dang byed 'gyur dge tshogs ci mchis kun// bla med byang chub dam pa 'grub pa'i rgyur// gegs med kho nar myur du 'gyur ba shog /skye ba kun tu rgyal ba'i bstan pa la// thos 37)bsam sgom pa yang dag lhur len cing*// yid bzhin rin chen lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes// rnyed nas rjes su 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig thos kyang dregs pas bcings ba ma yin zhing*// shes kyang rlom sems dug gis ma slad dang*// bsgoms kyang zhan 'dzin spun pas ma g.yogs par// gang byed chos su yang dag 'gyur bar shog /zang zing nor dang 'jig rten chos brgyad dang*// mi dge'i bshes gnyen sdig grogs la sogs pa// log lam phyogs su skad cig mi 'jug par// ma nor lam bzhugs mthun rkyen phun tshogs shog /dben pa'i gnas su bsgrub la brtson byas shing*// snang bzhi sgron drug nyams len mthar phyin te// rang don mngon gyur gzhan don dpag yas kyis// 'gro ba'i re skong rgyal por 'gyur bar shog /khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs bar// bdag ni gang 38)'dul sprul par yongs gyur nas// rgyal kun phrin las nyid dang mnyam pa yi// bstan dar 'gro la phan pa mchog 'grub shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa yun ring gnas par shog /bstan 'dzin skyes bu gzhan don 'grub par shog

/'gro kun bde zhing chos la spyod par shog /smon lam btab pa mtha' dag 'grub par shog ces pa 'di ni rnal 'byor pa lhun grub brda la khyab la'o// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse chu gter las// ngo mtshar rmad byung mtshan dpe'i nor bu mchog /gdul bya'i re skongs dam chos 'dod 'byung dbang*// mchog gi sprul sku'i zhabs pad brtan bzhugs gsol// snyigs dus gdul bya'i don du rim byon pa'i// skyes chen nor bu'i 'phreng ba dkrigs pa'i dbus// mkhyen rab thugs rje'i gzi mdangs cher gsal ba// rgyal sras mthu bo bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// smin grol gdams pa'i chu gter 39)rgya che zhing*// zab dgu'i man ngag rin chen gyis gang ba// gdul bya'i re ba skong mkhas thugs rje'i gter// nam mkha' ji srid gnas par brtan bzhugs gsol// bdag kyang skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs kun// khyed kyi phrin las bsgrub pa'i grogs nyid du// gyur zhing mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams kyi// ded dpon dam par gyur nas 'gro 'dren shog / ces pa 'di ni grwa dar rgyas chos sdings kyi sprul pa'i sku mchog dam pa'i drung du brtan bzhugs su phul ba'o// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje kun// gcig tu bsdus pa rdo rje'i slob dpon mchog /drin can bla ma rgyal ba'i bstan srog 'dzin// bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan bzhugs gsol// snyigs dus logs spyod skye 'gro 'dul dka' bas// mchog sprul mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku nyid kyang*// ma dag skye bas mthong ba'i skal med phyir// de slad gang 'dul der ston khyed bzhugs gsol/ 40)/rtsa rgyud bla ma rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor tshogs// srung mar bcas pa'i bden stobs thugs rje'i mthus// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab bstan 'dzin grags pa'i zhabs// chos 'khor rgyun mi chad mdzad brtan bzhugs gsol/

ces pa ni gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gi rigs dang chos kyi ring lugs dri ma med pa 'dzin par mdzad pa lho brag gnas gzhi chos kyi rje la brtan bzhugs su 'bul ba 'di nyid/ rje de nyid dang gdung rus gcig pa dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bskul ba ltar bkod pa'o// bden pa grub pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas kun// bdag gis smon lam 'grub par mdzad du gsol// bdag nyid skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs kun// dal 'byor mchog thob theg chen bstan dang mjal// mtshan ldan bshes gnyen dam pas rjes bzung nas// smin grol gdams pas rang rgyud smin par shog /mi mthun nyer 'tshe kun zhi mthun rkyen tshang*// dngos grub mchog brnyes phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub// gang 'dul rnam sprul rgya mtsho 41)'gyed nus pa'i// phrin las rgyal ba kun mtshungs 'grub gyur cig ces pa ni dge slong tshe dbang la'o// oṃ swasti sid+dhi/ bla med ston pa dkon mchog rnam gsum dang*// dkyil 'khor kun gtso rgyal mchog pad+ma 'byung*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung rgya mtsho'i mthus// bdag gis smon lam ci btab 'grub par shog /deng nas bzung ste gnas skabs thams cad du// bla med snying po byang chub bsgrub pa la// mi mthun 'gal rkyen ma lus zhi ba dang*// chos dang mthun pa'i dpal 'byor 'phel bar shog /skye ba kun tu theg chen dam chos dang*// rtag tu 'bral med mtshan ldan bshes gnyen gyis// rjes su bzung nas zab lam rdo rje'i theg /lam mchog mngon du gyur nas mthar phyin shog /snang zhing stong la stong bzhin gsal ba'i don// ye shes sgyu ma lta bu'i skur bzhengs nas// sprul pa sna tshogs 'jig rten khams kun tu// gang 'dul 42)phrin las rlabs chen spyod par shog /skye ba kun gyi rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs// mtha' dag gcig bsdus 'gro ba'i phan bde'i rgyun// dri med nyid gyur 'gro kun byang chub mchog

/myur du thob pa'i 'dren mchog nyid gyur cig /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs par// bdag gi rnam 'phrul dpag med mthu ldan gyis// ngo mtshar mdzad phrin rgyal kun gcig bsdus pa'i// mthu stobs nus ldan 'khor ba dong sprugs shog ces pa ni bsam gtan gling nas rig pa 'dzin pa pad+ma'i mtshan can gyis bskul ngor bkod pa'o// khams gsum 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje btsun chos kyi rje// bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /sna tshogs chos sgo brgya phrag gis phyug cing*// theg dgu'i khang bzang zab gnad bkod pa'i 43)'phrul// ngo mtshar dbang bsgyur rgyal ba'i phrin las pa// chos kyi rgyal khyod zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /'jig rten las 'das gsum brtsen pad tshal du// smin dbang grol khrid rin chen do shal can// dad ldan yid 'phrog mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba'i// 'chi med dbang po zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /khams gsum sems can dug lnga'i gcong nad kyis// rtag par gdungs ba'i nyon mongs zug rngu can// kun la theg pa'i bye brag sman tshogs kyis// phan mdzad sman rgyal khyed zhabs brtan gyur cig /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nyams thag rba klong ches// rab bskyod ngan song srin mo'i gling 'khyams pa'i// 'gro rnams bde ba'i skam sar sgrol mkhas pa// thar pa'i ded dpon zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /dad dus rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i tha ma 'dir// mgon po khyed las re 44)sa gzhan med na// bdag sogs gdul bya'i mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// dus 'di nas bzung phyi ma'i mthar thug bar// gus pas phyag 'tshal lus srog mchod par 'bul// sdig kun mthol bshags dge tshogs rjes yi rangs// mdzad bzang phrin las nam mkha' mnyam pa ru// bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs nas kyang*// tshad med byams chen thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// bstan pa'i mi mthun phyogs mun rab bsal zhing*// chos kyi snang ba rgya chen khyab mdzad gsol// rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs dpal ldan bla ma la// zhabs pad bstan par gsol ba btab pa'i dges// phyogs bcu'i zhing gi bde gshegs rgya mtsho la// chos 'khor bskor ba'i nus ldan bdag gyur cig

/skye ba kun tu dpal ldan bla ma la// mnyes pa gsum gyis zhabs 45)tog bsgrub byed cing*// khyod kyi phrin las nus stobs ci 'dra ba// de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang 'grub par shog ces pa 'di ni dge slong chos bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor bkod pa'o// bka' rgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin chos skyong dang*// dam can rgya mtsho srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi// rnam dag smon lam 'grub pa'i dpang mdzod cig /deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar// chos min bsam pa rgyud la mi skye zhing*// nyon mongs ngan blo'i rjes su mi 'breng bar// yang dag snying po'i don mchog spyod par shog /rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid dang ni// skye dang tshe rabs kun tu mi 'bral zhing*// rnam par dpag par dka' ba'i mdzad spyod la// ma dad log par rtog pa kun bral shog /'khor ba'i bya bzhag chu bo'i rba rlabs ltar// zin med las 'di ring du spangs byas 46)nas// snang bzhin stong la stong zhing gsal ba nyid// byar med lhug pa'i don la gnas par shog /dam pa'i don de legs par mngon gyur nas// skye 'gag gnyis med ngang la gnas byas shing*// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa dang*// chos nyid 'pho 'gyur med pa'i don rtogs shog ces pa ni snying po'i don la rtse gcig tu mos pa dad ldan o rgyan ming can la'o// phyogs bcu rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing kun gyis// bla ma sangs rgyas yi dam dkyil 'khor la// chos srung dam can dkar phyogs skyong rnams kyis// dbang bskur byin rlabs smon lam 'grub par mdzod// skye bar lha dang bla mas rjes bzung zhing*// thos bsam mthar phyin bsgrub la brtson byas te// rang don chos sku mngon gyur gzhan don du// rnam 'phrul du mas 'gro ba 'dren par shog ces pa 'di karma bzang ldan la'o// bla med 'dren pa rgyal ba dkon mchog tshogs// skyabs gnas 'phags tshogs bden pa'i

47)byin rlabs kyis// bdag gi lhag bsam dge ba'i smon lam kun// gegs med kho na nyid du 'grub gyur cig /skye bar dal 'byor chos ldan legs thob cing*// dri med rgyal bstan mchog la rab zhugs nas// gtan 'dun byang chub bsgrub la 'gal rkyen bral// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bde blag thob par shog /lhag bsam dag pas gzhan don mthar phyin cing*// sku gnyis mngon gyur rang don gdengs thob pas// srid zhir mi gnas thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar// tshe gcig nyid la phyin par mdzad du gsol/ ces pa ni karma bstan srung la'o// phyogs dus rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi// gtso mchog dpal ldan bla ma lhag pa'i lha// ma lus brtse ba'i dgongs pas nyer bzung ste// bdag gis smon lam gang btab 'grub par mdzod// khams gsum 'gro ba rgya chen don slad du// sna tshogs thabs 48)'phrul dpag med bsam yas kyis// phan bde'i sprin chen thugs rje'i char 'bebs pa'i// phrin las nam mkha' mnyam pa bdag 'grub shog /sangs rgyas byang sems bden pa'i thugs rje dang*// drang srong rig 'dzin rnams kyi mthu nus sogs// mtha' dag 'gro phan slad du bdag smon pa// yongs 'grub gegs med kho nar 'byung gyur cig ces pa ni karma rigs ldan la'o// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams dang*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs// skyabs gnas rnams kyi thugs rje nus mthu yis// smon lam ci btab gegs med 'grub par shog /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// dal 'byor mchog thob theg chen bstan dang mjal// thos bsam mthar phyin sgrub 'bras gdeng thob cing*// rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad med 'grub par shog /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs de srid du// bdag gi lhag bsam 49)rab dge'i smon lam mthu// 'dis mtshon phyogs dus rgyal ba'i phrin las rnams// myur du 'grub pa'i smon lam rtag grub shog

ces tshe ring bsam grub la'o// dpal ldan bla ma phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams// gcig bsdus yi dam dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal// bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs rmad po che// tshe gcig rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /skye ba 'di dang skye gzhan thams cad kyis// thos bsam sgom dang chos spyod bcu la sogs// dge kun pha ma mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// thar lam sgrod pa kho na'i don phyir bsngo// nam mkha' ji srid gnas par de srid du// bdag gis rnam sprul gang 'dul 'gyed nus shing*// 'gro la phan bde rgya chen stsol ba yi/ phrin las sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par shog ces karma brgya byin la'o// de ltar 'di dag ni dpal rnam thos kyi ri bo'i pho brang du bkod pa'o// mtha' yas zhing khams 50)rgya mtshor rab bzhugs pa'i// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas 'phags pa'i tshogs// smon lam thugs rje'i sprin las legs 'ongs pa'i// bde legs bkra shis char chen dbab tu gsol// phyogs bcu rab 'byams sna tshogs gdul bya'i khams// bgrang yas de snyed zab rgyas chos kyi sgo// kun gyi yang snying rmad byung rdo rje'i theg /dri med bstan pa yang dag rgyas par shog /bstan rtsa sde snod gsum gyi gser gzhi brtan// theg brgyad bang rim mngon mtho'i lhun po brjid// rim gnyis 'od gsal snying po nyi zla gsal// yang bcud rdzogs chen khang bzang dbang bsgyur shog /mtha' dad mos khams dang mthun grub pa'i mtha'// sna tshogs 'gro ba'i dpal du rab 'bar ba'i// grangs med chos sgo'i skar tshogs rnam bkra ba// ma lus nub med rtag par gsal gyur cig /lhar bcas mchod yul dkon mchog 'dus pa'i sde// rab 'phel mi phyed mthun 51)cing chos spyod bcu// rim gnyis thos bsam sgom pas dus 'da' zhing*// bzhed don ma lus gegs med myur 'grub shog /mthu ldan dkar po'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing*// log lta'i sde tshogs yang dag bstan la dad// 'gro kun mchod 'os bsten pa'i mthu 'bras kyis// 'jig rten bde ba'i dpal la nyer spyod shog

/srid pa ji srid gnas par rgyal ba'i bstan// 'grib bral yang dag gsal bas 'gro ba kun// byang chen bla med ma 'khod de srid du// mi 'jigs chos kyi chab srid brtan gyur cig ces pa bstan pa rgyas byed kyi smon lam 'di/ dbon po karma kun khyab kyi bskul ngor sman mo dgon gyi yang dben du bkod pa'o// oṃ maṅga laṃ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ bla ma dkon mchog yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// mthu stobs gter mdzod chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs// dkar phyogs skyong ba kun gyis bde legs dpal// gnas 52)'dir yongs su grub pa'i bkra shis stsol// tshogs gnyis mngon mtho'i mthu las legs grub cing*/ 'dod dgu'i dge 'bras du mas yongs gtams pa'i// dge legs yongs 'du'i dpal 'byor ji snyed pa// gnas 'dir yang yang 'byung ba'i bkra shis stsol// dug gsum rgyu 'bras nad kyi zug rngu dang*// 'khrul rtog bden zhan 'thas pa'i gdon bgegs sogs// brtan g.yo'i mi mthun rkyen rigs sna tshogs kun// yongs su zhi ba chen po'i bkra shis stsol// dus gsum bde dge 'byung ba'i longs spyod char// gtan 'dun byang chub bsgrubs pa'i mthun phyogs rkyen// srid dang srid min yongs kyi bsod nams gter// ma lus gong 'phel mchog gi bkra shis stsol// grub pa mchog brnyes rig 'dzin mtshar dngar bas// mchog gsang nges pa rnyes pa'i gnas mchog 'dir// nye bar brten rnams 'gal rkyen las grol zhing*// chos dang bkra shis bde legs 'phel bar shog

ces pa 'di yang bkra shis smon mo'i yang dben du'o// shes bya kun mkhyen ye shes mchog mnga' ba'i// bcom ldan lha yi lha dang de sras tshogs// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha dang chos srungs bcas// byin rlabs thugs rje'i char gyi dge legs stsol// 'gro khams mos pa rgya mtsho'i zhing sa ru// theg dgu brgyad khri bzhi stong dam chos char// rtag par rtsol mdzad phan bde'i 53)'byung gnas mchog /bstan pa rgya cher 'phel ba'i bkra shis stsol// yid bzhin 'dod 'byung grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i dbus// theg brgyad khri 'phang mngon mtho'i lhun po brjid// yang zab snying po'i rnam rgyal khang bzang dpal// rab 'bar mi 'gyur brtan pa'i dpal 'byor stsol// grangs med shes bya'i rgyu skar rnam bkra zhing*// mdo sngags nyi zla zung gi snang byed kyis// gdul bya'i mkha' la rim gnyis 'od 'bar ba// 'grib med rtag par gsal ba'i ngo mtshar stsol// rnam 'dren dge legs 'byung gnas dpag bsam shing*// bskal brgyar mya ngan bral kyang mya ngan las// 'da' tshul ston spangs srid zhi'i gdung sel dang*// gdul bya'i bya tshogs skyong ba'i bka' drin stsol// 'khor ba'i chu gter che las rab brgal nas/ 54)/thar pa dam pa'i gling du bgrod bzhed pas// bstan pa'i grur zhugs 'phags mchog 'dus pa'i sde// mi phyed kun tu mthun pa'i rten 'brel stsol// 'gro ba'i mchod sdong bstan mchog rin po che// gus ldan lhar bcas skye dgus rtag brten zhing*// srid pa ji srid gnas par skye 'gro yis// gtsug rgyan 'gran zla bral ba'i legs tshogs stsol// 'di ltar lhag bsam dge ba'i bden pa'i mthus// rgyal bstan phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa chen yongs khyab cing*// chos dang dpal 'byor gong 'phel bkra shis shog ces pa 'di ni phrin las don grub kyis bskur ba ltar/

smin grol bskyed rdzogs gling gi 'dus pa rnams kyis zhal 'don du mdzad phyir bkod pa'o// na mo gu ru bud+dha sarba maṅga laṃ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ rin chen gser gyi lhun po ji bzhin bsod nams dpal gyi sku mchog ni// lha dang mi dang lha ma yin sogs srid gsum 'gro 55)ba'i gtsug rgyan du// mtshan dpe'i me tog thugs rje'i gzi 'bar ston pa mnyam med shākya'i dbang*// chos dang dge 'dun sprul par bcas pa'i zhabs pad spyi bos rtag tu mchod// 'jig rten dge bar skyong ba'i mthu ldan tshangs pa dang*// brgya byin la sogs rgyal ba'i bka' sdod dkar phyogs kyi// mthu dpung ldan pa'i lha dang drang srong srung ma'i tshogs// ma lus deng 'dir bden pa grub pa'i dpang mdzod cig /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// 'phags pa byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal dang*// so skye lhag bsam nor ldan mtha' dag gi /dge kun rnam mkhyen bsngo rgyur lhun gyis grub// de bzhin bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams kyis// byas dang byed gyur yi rang la sogs pa'i// rnam dkar dge ba'i sa bon ji snyed kun// yongs bzlums rdzogs pa'i byang chub nyid du bsngo// thog med dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu// dpag med 56)drin ldan rigs drug pha ma'i tshogs// mtha' dag sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras kyis gzir ba// 'di las myur thar gtan bde thob par shog /bdag sogs skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs kun// mi khom brgyad po dag tu ma gyur pa'i// dal 'byor rin chen gru bo la brten nas// dam chos yid bzhin mchog la spyod par shog /gang du skyes kyang theg chen chos dang 'phrad// sangs rgyas dngos mtshungs dge ba'i bshes dang mjal// thos bsam bsgom pa mthar phyin grub mchog brnyed// bla na med pa'i go 'phang mngon gyur shog /yid la bsam pa'i don kun thogs med 'grub// lha dang bla ma mkha' 'gro rjes su bzung*// dam tshig sdom la nyes ltung dri ma med// rim gnyis rnal 'byor bstan pa thob par shog

/rgya chen chos la rmongs pa med pa yis// 'gro la dge legs chos char 'bebs pa dang*// rang don yid byed dri mas ma gos par/ 57)/gzhan phan nam mkha' mnyam pa 'grub par shog /gdul bya'i mos khams bsam yas ji snyed la// gang 'dul sprul pa rgya mtsho 'gyed nus shing*// phan bde'i char gyis 'gro ba'i zhing sa ru// byang chub dge legs myu gu bskyed par shog /dag snang mos gus phyogs med 'byongs pa yis// ris med bstan la bya ba byed pa dang*// rnam mang skye dgu'i mos skal dang mtshungs pa'i// dam chos zab mo'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog /bgrang yas 'jig rten phyogs bcu ma lus par// rgyal dang de sras sprul pas yongs khyab cing*// chos bstan mun sel ye shes sgron me gsal// 'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa rab sel shog /'byung po sha za mi ma yin la sogs// gzhan la 'tshe ba'i sems ldan thams cad kyang*// zhi zhing byams dang dge ba'i bsam pa yis// rang gzhan dge legs lam la 58)gnas par shog /nad dang rims dang rtsa sad ser ba dang*// phyugs kyi nad dang 'thab 'khrug rtsod pa'i rigs// pha rol mtha' yi dmag dpung la sogs pa// nye bar 'tshe kun gtan du mi 'byung shog /lo zla zhag dus gza' tshes skar ma dang*// 'byung ba'i 'phrod sbyor sa bdag ldan 'bras ngan// rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa la sogs pa// bkra mi shis pa thams cad zhi bar shog /char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs rtag tu legs// tshe ring 'byor pa 'phel dang mi nor rgyas// 'jig rten yid la smon dgu ji snyed dang*// bstan dang dam chos dar zhing rgyas par shog /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe phrin las 'phel// dge 'dun sde dar mi phyed mthun pa dang*// thos bsam bsgom bsgrub chos spyod mnga' thang rgyas// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur gsal bar shog /skye 'gro ma lus phan tshun rtag tu mthun/ 59)/yid la 'dod dgu 'grub cing bstan la dad// dam chos dge ba bsgrub brtson bar chad med// byang chub lam la kun kyang zhugs par shog

/bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje dang*// dkar phyogs chos srung rgya mtsho'i mthu rtsal dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag bden stobs kyis// smon lam gang btab thogs med 'grub par shog /tshe 'dir yid la ci bsam 'grub par shog /'chi khar gnad bcod sdug bsngal med par shog /bar do 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag bral bar shog /rang rig 'od gsal rang ngo shes par shog /skye med chos sku mngon du 'gyur bar shog /'gags med gzugs skus 'gro ba 'dul bar shog /thogs med sprul skus gdul bya 'dren par shog /sku gsum dbyer med 'gro don byed par shog /byin rlabs char 'bebs bla ma'i bkra shis shog /dngos grub kun stsol yi dam bkra shis shog /bar chad 60)sel mdzad mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog /bstan srung chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog /phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis bde legs shog ces pa 'di nor 'dzin dbang po bdag gis bskul ngor bkod pa'o// dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong byin rlabs bden mthu yis// bdag gi bsam pa chos mthun 'grub pa dang*// 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol// 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob par// chos min bsam pa rgyud la mi skye zhing*// lhan skyes ma rig mun pas mi sgrib par// rang rig gdod ma'i gnas lugs mngon gyur shog /phyi rol bzung ba'i yul phyir mi 'breng zhing*// nang gi 'dzin pa'i sems kyis 'ching bral bas// cir snang khyab gdal ye shes dkyil 'khor cher// rang grol lhan skyes ye shes rtogs par shog /bsgom du med pa'i rang 61)byung rig pa'i don// yengs su med pa'i dran pa bcos min nyid// lhun grub rang gsal don gyi 'od sku dang*// dbyer med gdod ma'i mgon po mchog 'grub shog ces rdzogs chen yang ti nag po dang mthun pa'i smon lam zhig dgos zhes shākya dpal 'byor gyis bskul ngor bkod pa'o//

srid gsum lha ma'i mchod pa'i gnas gcig pu// ston pa dam pa'i chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs// ma lus 'gro ba'i bla ma sras bcas kyis// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun rjes bzung gsol// bdag gis 'khor 'das dus gsum bsags pa'i dge /mtha' dag nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bla med byang chub rgyu ru yongs bsngo ba'i// 'bras bu phan bde dpag med 'grub par shog /bdag kyang 'di bzung skye ba thams cad du// yon tan bdun ldan dpal 'byor rin chen dang*// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i mtshan ldan bla ma dang*// dam chos 'dod dgu'i 'byor bcas 62)lhun grub shog /sdig spong dge ba bsgrub la brtson pa dang*// thos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan mngon gyur cing*// rang gzhan don gnyis gegs med lhun grub pas// rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i nus mthu dang*// chos srung dkar phyogs skyong ba'i stobs rtsal mthus// bdag gis rnam dkar lhag bsam bden tshig sogs// gcig bsdus smon lam ci btab 'grub gyur cig ces pa ni karma dge ba la'o// rgyal kun ye shes dbyings su ro gcig pa'i// thugs rje rmad du byung ba'i gong bu mchog /rab 'byams gdul bya'i dpal du cher 'bar ba// bstan pa'i nyi ma 'gro blo'i mun sel nyid// zab yangs thugs rje bri gang las 'das kyang*// snyigs dus las nyon gyis gdungs 'gro mang 'di'i// skyabs mdzad khyed las gzhan med de slad du// bskal brgyar mi 'gyur rdo rje gdan bzhugs shing*/ mchog gsang nges pa don gyi chos 63)'khor che// rgyun chad med pa'i ngo mtshar phrin las ni// srid pa ji srid gnas par yongs stsol bar// gsol ba btab pa don ldan 'grub gyur cig ces pa ni mtshungs bral rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying po'i drung du brtan bzhugs su phul ba'o// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/

byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ e ma/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam mar gyur 'gro ba rnams// 'di nas bzung ste bla med byang chub bar// ngan song gsum du nam yang mi skye zhing*// mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan thob par shog /dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang ba'i lus thob nas// mtshan nyid kun ldan bla ma rnyed pa dang*// dam tshig nyams chags dri mas ma gos par// mnyes pa gsum gyi zhabs tog bsgrub par shog theg chen dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba dang*/ 64)/thos bsam sgom la skyo ngal med pa dang*// bsgrub la rab brtson nyams rtogs mthar phyin nas// rang don chos sku mngon du 'gyur bar shog /dam chos sgrub la bar chad med pa dang*// lha dang bla mas byin gyis rlobs pa dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bu ltar skyong ba yis// rnam bzhi'i phrin las rtsol med 'grub par shog /gnas skabs mthar thug 'gal rkyen med pa dang*// chos mthun 'dod dgu lhun gyis grub pa dang*// rlabs chen gzhan don 'bad med 'byung ba yi// 'gro 'dul sprul pa mtha' yas 'gyed par shog /gdod nas dag pa chen po gzhi yi dbyings// rim gnyis bde stong gsal rig lam gyi mchog /zung 'jug ye shes lhun grub 'bras bu cher// 'khrul bral 'gyur med gtan srid zin par shog /rig stong spros pa bral ba phyag rgya che// 'od gsal mngon sum ye shes rdzogs 65)chen gnad// dbyer med yengs 'dzin zhen bral snying po'i don// ma nor mngon gyur tshe gcig sangs rgyas shog /tshe 'di'i snang bas g.yeng ba spong ba dang*// bar do rang snang 'khrul pas ma slad cing*// nam yang gdams pa'i gnad dang mi 'bral bar// sku gsum go 'phang yang dag thob par shog /bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug par shog /rang don tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /gzhan don 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par shog /rgyal kun phrin las bdag gi 'grub par shog /smon lam btab pa mtha' dag 'grub par shog

ces pa'i smon lam 'di ni chos dbyings dpal mo dang byang chub mtsho mo grogs mched gnyis kyi bskul ngor bris pa'o// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rgyal ba kun bdag nyid// thugs rje'i sprul 'khor bcas pa yis// bdag dang mkha' khyab 'gro kun la// rjes bzung byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ dal 'byor rin chen phun tshogs 66)thob// bla ma rje dang mi 'bral zhing*// rdo rje theg la spyod par shog /dam chos tshul bzhin spyad nas kyang*// log pa'i lam du mi 'jug cing*// chos mthun 'dod dgu phun tshogs nas// rtse gcig bsgrub la brtson par shog /sgrub pa'i bar chad 'gal rkyen rigs// cung zad tsam yang mi 'byung zhing*// nyams rtogs yon tan mthar phyin te// mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog /lam rtags bzang ngan 'char sgo la// zhen 'dzin rtog pas ma slad cing*// yengs 'khrul bcos ma'i dri bral ba'i// gnas lugs chos sku mngon gyur shog /rang don chos nyid mthar phyin nas// gzhan don gzugs sku'i rol gar gyis// gang 'dul sprul sku'i phrin las mchog /srid pa ji srid khyab mdzad shog ces pa 'di yang byang chub mtsho mo la'o// skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum dang*// bla ma rgyal 67)ba sras bcas bden mthu yis// bdag sogs skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs kun// dal 'byor dam chos ldan pa'i lus thob shog /theg chen bstan pa dar ba'i yul du skyes// mtho ris yon tan bdun gyi dpal 'byor ldan// sangs rgyas dngos mtshungs bla mas rjes su bzung*// log pa'i spyod spong dge ba bsgrub brtson cing*// dam chos dri ma med la mos 'jug shog /don med 'khrul pa'i las la mi 'byams par// thar pa byang chub bsgrub la myur gzhol shog /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i klong du mi 'khyams shing*// gtan bde nges legs lam la goms thob shog /ma nor zab mo'i gdams pa nyams blangs te// tshe gcig rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/sprul pa rgya mtsho gang 'dul phrin las kyis/ mkha' mnyam 'gro ba thugs rjes 'dren par shog /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyis 68)legs gsungs pa'i// smon lam mtha' dag bdag gi 'grub par shog ces pa 'di ni kun dga' lha dbang la'o// e ma/ bslu ba med pa'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog tshogs// ma lus cig bsdus bla ma rigs kyi bdag /byin rlabs thugs rje nus rtsal rmad byung bas// bdag gi smon lam gegs med 'grub par mdzod// skye ba grangs med da lta yan chod kyi// dri med rnam dkar dge tshog mtha' dag dang*// rim gnyis zab gsal don mchog gang bsgom pa'i// 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa'i mthu byin dang*// tshe 'dir rnam 'dren mchog gi sku drin gyis// rang byung ye shes rang zhal blta ba dang*// theg pa'i rtse rgyal rdzogs pa chen po'i don// ma nor mngon sum gnas la gang spyod pa'i// nyams len bgyis dang bgyid 'gyur kun tu yang*// chos brgyad tshe 'di'i sgrog gis ma bcings shing*// zhen 'dzin lha bu'i 69)bdud kyis ma slad par// sku gsum don gyi zhing khams mthong bar shog /ma dag 'khrul pa'i sgyu mas ma bslus shing*// log rtog mtshan 'dzin sgyu lus gzugs phung 'di// yang dag 'od gsal sgyu ma 'ja' skur grol// ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyi 'gro grol shog /gal te tshe 'dir 'od lus ma 'grub par// rnam smin gdos bcas 'dor ba de yi tshe// 'byung lnga'i phung po chags gnas 'jig pa'i tshul// gnad don shes pas mi 'tshor brod 'gyur shog /las rlung logs pas 'khor lnga'i mdud pa 'jig /mnyam gnas 'chug pas drod nyams zas mi len// srog 'dzin log pas shes pa mi gsal dang*// thur sel 'chugs pas rtsa chu mi snyom 'chor// gyen rgyu 'chugs pas kha zas nang mi 'phul// khyab byed 'chugs pas 70)yan lag las mi rung*// dbugs thung rtsa brtul mal mthar nyal ba'i tshe// 'di nang chags sdang sred zhen mi 'byung shog

/lte 'khor 'jig pas sa khams chur thim dus// phyi rtags lus lci nang rtags shes pa bying*// gsang rtags 'od gsal smig rgyu 'char ba'i tshe// snying gar bla ma chos skur sems zin shog /snying ga'i 'khor 'jig chu khams mer thim dus// phyi ru kha sna skam zhing nang rtags su// shes pa rab 'tshubs gsang rtags du ba 'char// lte bar bla ma bsgom las ma yengs shog /mgrin pa'i 'khor 'jig me khams rlung thim tshe// phyi ru drod 'chor nang du shes pa 'khrul// mi ngo mi shes gsang rtags me khyer 'char// bla ma dpral bar bsgom zhing mi 'khrul shog /gsang gnas 'khor 'jig rlung khams rnam shes thim// phyi rtags dbugs brtsegs nang rtags mthong snang 71)mang*// gsang rtags sgron me lta bu'i 'od gsal 'char// gsang gnas bla ma longs skur ngo shes shog /dbang po lnga 'gags rnam shes nam mkhar thim// srog rtsar khrag 'dus snying phog phyi dbugs chad// dkar dmar khams kyi gnas 'phos dbu mar brgyud// dkar lam dmar lam shar ba ngos zin shog /byang sems gnyis phrad bar du rnam shes 'thum// nag lam 'char zhing rang bzhin brgyad bcu 'gags// nam mkha' 'od gsal la thim sprin med mkha'// ji bzhin 'od gsal chos skur grol bar shog /gal te ngang der grol bar ma nus kyang*/ nang dbugs chad tshe rig pa skar mda' ltar// tshangs pa'i lam brgyud bla ma'i thugs kar thim// myur lam 'pho bas mkha' spyod bsgrod par shog /ci ste chos nyid bar do mthong nas yang*// 'od gsal zung 'jug la thim sgra 'od zer// zhi dang 72)khro tshogs 'jig rten khams gang zhing*// snang srid 'od skur 'char ba ngo shes shog /rigs lnga 'khor bcas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor dang*// rang lus 'od du snang ba'i thugs ka'i bar// zer thag 'brel shar rang bzhin bsam gtan gnas// 'jug pa shes pa'i gnad kyis grol bar shog /ye shes bzhi sbyor 'od lam shar ba na// ngo shes gdeng thob btsan sa zin pa dang*// lhun grub rin chen snang ba 'char gyur kyang*// mngon shes drug dang rjes dran drug la sogs// chos rnams kun las rang byan legs tshud cing*// 'char lugs brgyad sogs gnad don khong chud de// ma dag 'khor ba'i sgo la mi 'jug par// dag pa ye shes sgo la gdeng thob shog

cis kyang bag chags 'khrul dbang song tshe yang*// srid pa bar dor nying mtshams mi sbyor bar// rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su/ pad+ma'i sbubs las skyes shing chos nyan shog 73)/rigs lnga la sogs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun// gcig bsdus khyab bdag rgyal dbang pad+ma yis// dbang bskur lung bstan dbugs dbyung bzengs bstod de// mngon par sangs rgyas sprul pa 'gyed nus shog /nam mkha' ji srid gnas par 'gro ba'i don// dpag med lhun gyis grub pa 'byung ba ru// smon lam btab pa 'di bzhin legs 'grub par// sras bcas rgyal ba rnams kyis mdzad du gsol//

ces bar do thams cad kyi smon lam mdor bsdus te nyams len gyi rtsa tshig lta bur bkod pa 'di yang skal ldan tshul khrims bzang pos bskul nas bris pa lags shing*/ 'di ni kun la spyir yang gal che la khyad par yang nyams khrid dang bar do'i gdams pa zhu myong ba'i gang zag rnams smon lam 'di rgyun du yid la 'dris shing nges par byas na/ 'chi khar ngo sprod gsal 'debs gzhan la re mi dgos pa yod pas cis kyang nan tan du mdzad 'tshal/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ 74)mthas yas thugs rje mnga' ba'i bcom ldan 'das// sras bcas rgyal ba'i khyab bdag bla ma rje// rnam 'phrul yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs// ma lus nyams thag 'gro ba skyab tu gsol// thog med dus nas ngan goms 'khrul rtog gis// rab bskyod mi bzad 'khor ba'i mtsho chen 'dir// sdug bsngal rnam pa mang pos rtag gzir ba'i// 'gro kun thar pa'i lam la 'jug gyur cig /bstan rtsa sde snod gsum gyi gser gzhi brtan// theg chen byang chub sems kyi lhun po brjid// bla med rim gnyis nyi zla 'od gsal 'bar// rnam grol byang chub gling la dbang 'byor shog /gsung rab rin chen gling du bde blag bgrod// rnam 'dren ded dpon dam pa gtsug tu bsten// 'dod 'byung yid bzhin chos la rang dbang bsgyur// don gnyis 'bras bu'i mchog 'grub gegs med shog /gdod nas 75)dag pa chos sku'i gtan srid zin// 'gags med gsal gdangs longs sku'i zhing khams rgyas// rnam rol sprul sku'i rtsal gyis 'gro ba 'dren// zung 'jug 'dus ma byas dbyings grol bar shog ces pa ni/ dge slong karma yongs dag la'o// skyabs gnas dkon mchog ma lus bla ma'i skur// gcig bsdus mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes myur gzigs nas// 'jigs skrag bar do'i 'phrang las skyabs su gsol// 'dus byas mi rtag rang tshul mngon sum bstan// skyes pa'i mtha' de 'chi bar thag chod cing*// 'dus byas sgyu ma'i lus kyi rtag mi thub// brtse ba'i spyan gyis gzigs shig bla ma rje// tshe yi tshad rdzogs 'byung bzhi'i nus pa nyams// sman gyi mi phan zas skom dang kha 'grib// lus sems 'bral ba'i dus la babs pa na// tshe 'di chags zhen bral bar byin gyis rlobs/

76)/nam kyang mi sdod shi bar thag chod la// da rung gson du re ba'i 'dod blo yis// rang mgo rang gi bskor na 'phung tshabs che// 'chi ba lam du lhongs par byin gyis rlobs// las rlung 'khrug pa'i stobs kyi rang lus 'di'i// spyi mgrin snying kha lte ba gsang gnas kyi// 'khor lo lnga yi rtsa mdud 'jig pa'i mthus// gnad gcod zug ngu rang sar zhi bar shog /'pho ba'i me nyams rlung 'chugs zas mi len// srog 'dzin rlung 'chugs shes pa mi gsal dang*// thur sel rlung 'chugs dri ma che chung 'chor// rlung nus nyams pa'i rtags su ngo shes shog /gyen rgyu'i rlung 'chugs zas skom mid mi thub// gtam gyi smra brjod dka' zhing dbugs sna thung*// khyab byed rlung gi nus zad 'gul skyod dka'// de tshe 'chi bar thag chod 'gyod med shog /gdos bcas lus 'di dang po 'byung bzhis bskyed// mthar yang 77)'byung bzhi gcig la gcig thim 'chi// phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags snang 'char ba rnams// ngo shes bla ma yid la dran par shog /sa khams chur thim lus kyi nus stobs zad// nang gi rtags su shes pa bying zhing rmongs// gsang rtags mthong snang mig rgyu lta bu 'char// der yang bla ma dran las ma yengs shog /chu khams me la thim pas kha sna'i chu// cung zhig thon te skoms shing smra brjod 'gags// shes pa 'tshub cing gsang rtags du ba ltar// ban bun lang long 'char ba ngo shes shog /me khams rlung la thim pas lus drod chad// nang rtags mi ngo mi shes dbang po 'khrul// gsang rtags srin bu me khyer lta bu'i sems// res gsal res mi gsal 'gyur ngo shes shog /rlung khams rnam shes la thim phyi dbugs chad// nang rtags 'khrul pa'i mthong snang sna tshogs 'char// gsang rtags sgron me 'bar ltar rig 78)pa gsal// de dus zab lam 'pho ba dran par shog /rnam shes nam mkha'i khams thim tshogs drug 'gags// spyi bo'i dkar cha thur du babs pa dang*// lte ba'i dmar cha gyen du ldog pa'i bar// rnam par shes pa 'thum pa ngo shes shog

/khams gnyis gyen 'thur 'phos pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis// rang snang dkar lam dmar lam nag thom 'char// dug gsum rang bzhin rtog pa brgyad cu 'gags// snang mched thob pa'i 'od du ngo shes shog /dkar dmar rlung sems dbu mar gnas pa'i mthus// gdod nas dag pa'i bde gshegs snying po nyid// lhad med gzhi yi 'od gsal chos kyi sku// rang la mngon sum 'char ba ngo shes shog /de nyid sgom gyis stobs zhan ma grol na// nang dbugs chad nas chos nyid bar do shar// lus sems bral nas sgra 'od zer gsum gyis// stong khams khyab pa rang snang yin shes shog /'ja' 'od thig le thig phran 'od lam dang*// zhi dang khro bo'i lha tshogs ci 79)shar kun// chos nyid rang sgrar bcas la mi skrag par// rang rig chos nyid ye shes ngo shes shog /gal te las nyon sgrib pas ma grol na*// srid pa bar do'i 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi dang*// ma nges rtags drug ya nga'i g.yang gsum sogs// thams cad bden med sgyu mar shes par shog /shi ba ngo shes bla ma snying nas dran// des gsungs gdams pa'i gnad la nges pa brnyed// ma dag 'khor ba'i mngal sgo mi 'tshol bar// pad+ma 'od kyi zhing du 'pho bar shog /mdor na dus dang rnam pa de kun tu// ci drag blo sna mang pos 'phung 'gyur bas// rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan dbyer med la// skad cig tsam yang ma yengs blo gtad shog /bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med 'dres// rang rig chos sku'i gtan srid zin nas kyang*// smon lam thugs rje'i sprul pas mkha' 80)mnyam gyi// sems can byang chub mchog la 'god par shog ces 'chi kha bar do'i gdams ngag ngag 'don 'di ni dbon po rta mgrin rdo rje dang smin grol snying po sogs kyi ngor bkod pa yin la/ 'di yang rgyun du blo la 'jags pa zhig med na/ shi khar gdams ngag de dpe la lus te/ rang la phan pa mi 'byung bas/ de phyir rgyun 'khyer du bya phyir gsol 'debs smon lam gyi tshul du byas pa yin la/

'di nyid tshig nyung ngur bsdoms pa'i bshis kyis go dka' na spyir thos grol chen mo'i bar do gsol 'debs dang khyad par kho bos byas pa'i bar do'i spyi don dran pa'i me long du gsal bar bkod pa la gzigs 'tshal/ zhes bya bral sna tshogs rang grol gyis dpal ri'i rgod phug mya ngan med pa'i nags khrod du bris pa'o// ༈ rgyal kun ye shes thugs rje gcig bzlum pa// pad 'byung 'dzam gling grags dang rat+na'i zhabs/ 'ja' tshon bzang po rdo rje legs grub rtsal// skyabs gnas bla med thugs rje nus mthu yis/ 'di bzung skye ba'i 81)lug brgyud ji snyed par// chos kun snying po phyag rgya chen po dang*// dam chos 'dul ba'i kun spyod zung 'jug nyid// rang blo'i mtha' rgod 'dul sbyong thog tu khel// lta spyod rnam dag 'brel pas bstan srog zin// smon lam byang sems nus pas 'gro don 'grub// dri med rgyal sras spyod pa brlabs chen la// rang gzhan bde blag 'khod pa nyid gyur cig ces rig 'dzin chos nyid klong grol gyi thugs bzhed bskong phyir/ bya bral sna tshogs rang grol gyis rgod phug nas phul ba maṅga laṃ// na mo/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams// brtse ba chen pos bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i smon lam 'di// gegs med kho nar 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ 'khor ba thog ma med nas 82)da lta'i bar// slad mar byang chub snying por mchis kyi ring*// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa'i dge rtsa kun// gcig bsdoms smon lam 'grub pa'i rgyur bsngo'o// deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs rnams su yang*// phun tshogs dal 'byor thob pas don ldan bsgrub// 'dus byas mi rtag go bas nges 'byung skyes// dam chos phyi bshol med par brtson par shog /'khor ba'i rang mtshang rig pas zhen pa ldog /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel shes pas blang dor brtson// 'gro kun pha mar shes pas chags sdang bral// sems rgyud dam pa'i chos la 'gro bar shog

/tshul khrims 83)bslab pas nyes ltung rtsad nas 'byin// ting 'dzin bslab pas sgo gsum g.yeng ba spong*// shes rab bslab pas blo yi mun pa sangs// skyes bu chung ngu'i lam rim kun rdzogs shog /theg dman rang zhi'i 'dod bder ma chags par// smon sems dge legs gru chen la zhugs nas// 'jug sems pha rol phyin bcu'i skya ba yis// 'gro kun srid mtsho sgrol ba'i stobs ldan shog /rang don ched gnyer byis pa'i blo med par// gzhan don rlabs chen spyod pa'i snying stobs kyis// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel la bskal mang tshogs// nam yang skyo ngal med par brtson 'grus shog /sems can don 84)du rgyal sras spyod zhugs la// pha rol gzhan gyi 'tshe zhing log bsgrub sogs// kun yang byang chub sems kyi gsal 'debs su// gyur nas gnod lan phan bdes 'jal bar shog /skyes bu 'bring lam chog par mi 'dzin par// zab myur bde bas yid skyobs rdo rje'i theg /skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs bla ma dang*// lhan cig brnyed nas gus pas bsten par shog /bum dbang zab mos snod bcud zhing khams 'byong*// gsang dbang rtsa thig rlung gsum las rung smin// shes rab ye shes lhan skyes rang zhal mthong*// tshig gi dbang 85)thob don gyis rgyud grol shog /kha dog dbyibs la lhar zhen ma yin par// phung khams gzod nas dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho ru// lhun grub mchog gi bskyed rim mngon gyur cing*// lha sngags ye shes rol rtsal dbang thob shog /mtshan bcas don med a 'thas zhen bral zhing*// mtshan med stong 'dzin chad mthar mi lhung bar// zung 'jug lam gyi yang snying ji bzhin pa// nyams len ma nor gnad du bsnun byed shog /gnas lugs rjen par rtags pas phyag rgya che// chos kun sems la rdzogs pas rdzogs chen dang*// mtha' kun rig ngor bral phyir dbu ma'i don/ 86) /sgribs bral rang sems rig ste grol bar shog

/lam 'bras snying po bzhi la gdengs chen thob// zhi byed zab mo sdug bsngal sems su shes// gcod yul drag pos ngar 'dzin 'dre chen thul// blo sbyong mthar thu+ug rang rgyud 'thul bar shog /sor bsam gnyis kyis kun rtog rba rlabs zhi// srog rtsol nus pas zag med bde chen myong*/ rjes ting mthar phyin sku gsum rgyal sa zin// yan lag drug don mngon du 'gyur bar shog /gtum mo sgyu lus nyin snang 'khrul rtog chod// smi lam 'od gsal mtshan mo'i nying 'khrul sangs// bar do 'pho bas dus mtha'i 'jigs chen grol// zab lam chos drug don 'bras 'grub par shog /rnam rtog ngo shes nyon mongs gnad gyis zin// na tsha 87)lam lhongs lha 'dre rdzun 'tshong rig /sdug bsngal rtsa bral 'chi ba nyams 'og chud// ro snyoms drug la gdengs chen thob par shog /chos rnams thams cad rang sems 'dul ba'i thabs// sems nyid sku gsum ye nas 'du 'bral med// ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i 'khor los rang mgo 'khor// rang sems sku gsum rang bzhin klong grol shog /lam lnga sa bcu'i rgyun mtha'i ring bskor gyis// grangs med bskal bar bsags sbyangs ma ltos pa'i// skad cig nyid la rdzogs 'tshang rgya nus pa'i// snod bcud rkyen gsum 'bad med tshogs par shog /gzhi yi bar chad lhan cig ma rig pa// lam gyi bar chad phyi nang gsang ba'i gegs*// 'bras bu'i bar chad 88)bdag lta'i 'dzin phra sogs/ byang chub bar chad rtsad nas chod par shog /dus min 'gro don gzugs brnyan slu byed kyis// rang gzhan gnyis phung 'dun ma mi byed par// dus babs rtsol bral rlabs chen 'gro ba'i don// nam mkha' mtha' mnyam rgyun mi chad 'grub shog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang rgyal sras ma lus kyis// sems can don du smon lam ci btabs dang*/ /de 'grub gzhan phan rgya chen gang mdzad pa// thams cad gcig bsdoms bdag gis 'grub gyur cig

de ltar chos thams cad lam gyi rim pa'i gnad don 'gag bsdus smon 89) lam gyi brjod bgyis te nyam len gyi gsal 'debs dran bskul du 'gyur ba 'di nyid legs byas rgya mtsho lta bu'i dpal mngon par rgyas pa'i gzi 'od kyis bkra ba skyes chen karma mi pham mgon po'i bzhed pa yongs su bskang ba'i slad kho nar/ kun spangs pa'i spyod la mngon par dga' ba karma rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal bas phul ba sid+dhi rastu// bskal bzang 'dren pa stong gi gser ri'i dbus// thugs rje'i mthu stobs mngon 'phags lhun pa'i dbang*// zas gtsang sras kyi rgyal tshab thu bo ru// dbang bskur zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa nyid// lnga bdo'i rnam 'gyur dar ba'i bsil ldan yul// gang 'dir bstan gnyis sgron ma sbar ba'i mgon// lha lam khyab pa'i dbus na sprin bral nyi// 'dzam gling grags pa'i 'od zer tshar ngar gdung*// dri med sgrub brgyud bstan srogs 'dzin pa'i dpal// chos nyid ji bzhin gzigs pa mngon gyur gyis// chos can ji snyed ye 90)shes klong grol ba'i// 'dren pa mchog khyed bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// rgyal dgongs gdod nas yongs dag 'gyur med gshis// 'khor 'das dus gsum ro mnyam chen po ru// 'tsho zhing gzhes las nam yang ma g.yos bzhin// gdul bya'i snang ngor de bzhin bzhugs gsol 'debs// mi zad thugs rje'i gter mnga' rgyal ba'i tshogs// 'chi med rig 'dzin grub dbang sprul 'khor bcas// byin rlabs mthu dang chos nyid bden stobs kyis// gsol ba btab pa don ldan 'grub gyur cig ces rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin mchog gi skyes chen rig pa 'dzin pa chos dbyings klong grol dpal bzang po'i zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba gdab pa 'di nyid/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi ming 'dzin pa'i bya bral bas/ lhag bsam rnam par dkar bas kun nas blangs te phul ba dge legs gong 'phel du gyur cig

/rgyal kun thugs rje'i zlos gar sgyu 'phrul las// bud+dha dzñā na rig 'dzin ā nan+ta/ 91)/bstan pa bsrung mdzad bsod nam chos 'phel mtshan// skyes chen 'phreng bar brgyud pa'i mdo 'dzin du// dpal ldan dwags rgyud bstan pa'i sgron me ru// sangs rgyas dngos byon rat+na badz+ra nyid// gdul bya'i dad mtshor mkhyen brtse'i zla snang gi /mtshan dper bstan mdzad sprul pa'i skyes mchog gang*// gsang gsum mi zad rgyan 'khor g.yo med brtan// thos bsam sgom pa'i snang ba 'grib med gsal// phan bde'i phrin las 'od brgyas yongs khyab par// rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi dge legs stsol/ 'di ni dwags lha sgam por zhabs drung mthu stobs bstan 'dzin dbang po'i sder phul ba'i brtan bzhugs chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse nas so// bslu med skyabs gnas dkon mchog kun 'dus pa// bla ma mchog gi thugs rjes gzigs mdzod la// rnam dkar yid kyi smon lam gang btab pa// gegs med 92)myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// deng nas bzung ste rnam mkhyen ma thob bar// bla ma mchog gi gdul byar 'gyur bar shog /mtshan nyid kun ldan bla ma sangs rgyas la// kha zhe med pa'i mos gus brtan par shog /lus dang longs spyod gtan gyi 'dun mar bcas// ltos med bla ma'i don du stong nus shog /ci mdzad legs mthong ci gsungs tshad ma 'dzin// dag snang zol med rgyud la skye bar shog /'gal 'khrul nyes ltung spu tsam mi gsog par// ci byed bla ma mnyes pa nyid 'gyur shog /gdams ngag zab mo gsung gi bdud rtsi la// rgyun chad med par 'thung ba'i skal ldan shog /thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab dri med kyis// gang gsungs chos kyi dgongs pa lon par shog /kha tshig go yul tsam la mi 'jog par// gdams ngag rtse gcig nyams su lon par shog /nyams rtogs 93) yon tan lam rtags tshul bzhin shar// sa lam spangs rtogs mtha' ru phyin par shog

/nam yang sdig pa'i grogs kyis ma bslus shing*// chos mthun grogs dang mthun rkyen 'dzom par shog /'jig rten rnam g.yeng grong la mi chags par/ rgyal bas bsngags pa'i ri khrod 'grim par shog /dkor nag log 'tsho sdig zas sha chang la// sred zhen med sogs dka' thub 'tsho nus shog /chos brgyad tshe 'di'i bya byed mi bsgrub par// bya bral dman sa 'dzin pas dus 'da' shog /phung byed sgyu ma'i nor rdzas mi gsog par// dgos med zhen log snying nas skye bar shog /skyid 'dod longs spyod 'du 'dzi mi byed par// grub thob brgyud pa'i rnam thar 'khyongs par shog /dal 'byor stong zad g.yengs ba mi 'khyer bar// nges 'byung mi rtag 'chi ba dran par shog /nyon mong bag chags nad 94)ro mi ldang bar// tshul khrims gtsang mas rang rgyud dag par shog /blo chung dman pa'i zhi bde mi bsgrub par// dge 'dun mkha' khyab 'gro la phan nus shog /chos min bsam spyod skad cig mi byed par// sgo gsum chos kyis nyin mtshan 'da' bar shog /bla ma mched grogs pha ma sems can la// dag snang phyogs med zhabs tog 'grub par shog /snod bcud thams cad gzod nas dkyil 'khor lha// yin tshul shes pas dag par rab 'byams shog /phung khams skye mched sgo gsum ye shes kyi// rdo rje mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor shog /tshogs drug yul snang 'char sgo ma lus kun// chos nyid rnam rol chen por grol bar shog /na tsha rkyen ngan zug rngu ci byung kyang*// bde chen rang rig klong du grol bar shog /dgra gdon gnod byed rnam 'gyur gang la yang*// nyam nga bral zhing byang chub sems 'byongs shog 95)/me chu g.yang sogs 'byung ba'i 'jigs pa la// bden med rmi lam sgyu mar shes par shog /gzhan gyi tshig rtsub ngan smras ci byas kyang*// 'dzin med brag cha'i sgra ltar rtogs par shog /rnyed dang bkur bsti 'dod yon tshogs rnams la'ang*// chags med zhen bral re 'dod spong bar shog

/gang du gnas kyang dam pa'i chos ma gtogs// 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i bya ba mi byed shog /su dang 'grogs kyang dag snang 'byongs gyur nas// 'thab 'khrug 'khon rtsod las ngan mi gsog shog /sgo gsum bskyed rdzogs don las mi g.yel ba'i// rtag par dran dang shes bzhin ldan par shog /nyin snang 'khrul med dran rig rgyun chags kyis// gnyid dang rmi lam 'khrul phyir mi 'breng shog /tshe 'di chos kyi 'da' ba'i nus stobs kyis// 'chi khar 'gyod 'tsher 96)ya nga med par shog /mtshams sbyor ngan pa'i rkyen dbang mi 'gro bar// gdams pa dran zhing gnad gcod med par shog /sgra 'od zer dang 'jigs skrag ci shar yang*// rang mdangs yin pa'i gnad don rtogs par shog /bar dor bla ma'i gdams ngag dran nas kyang*// lam log 'khrul phyir mi 'brang grol bar shog /rang don 'gyur med chos sku'i gtan srid zin// gzhan don gzugs sku'i rnam 'phrul 'gyed par shog /gang 'dul sprul pa nam mkha' gar khyab tu// 'gro la phan bde'i char rgyun 'bebs par shog /bdag gis smon lam 'di ltar gang btab rnams// myur 'grub mkha' mnyam 'gro kun byang chub shog/

ces pa 'di ni smin grol snying po la'o// rgyal ba ma lus chos sku'i ngang nyid du// ro mnyam rigs 'dus bla ma gcig pu'i skur// gzod ma nyid nas lhun gyis grub par ru// yin 97)lugs ji bzhin rtogs pas gsol ba 'debs// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa sangs par byin gyis rlobs// ngar 'dzin 'gong po'i bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// lo 'dod chos brgyad gdon gyis mi skyod par// rang rig chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par shog /'di nas bzung ste bla med byang chub la// ma 'khod de srid 'jig rten 'khor ba'i blo// rdul cha phra mo tsam gyis ma gos par// rin chen byang chub sems mchog 'byongs par shog /chags sdang 'khrul pa'i rang gzugs dgra gnyen zhes// log rtog sgyu ma'i mngon zhen rmi lam la// bden zhen byis pa'i rnam thar mi ston par// 'gro kun pha mar shes pas phan sgrub shog /rang skyon ri bo tsam yang ma mthong bzhin// gzhan skyon phra mo'ang mthong ba'i mig rnon pos// dag snang 98)mthong tshul go log mi byed par// snod bcud rgyal ba'i zhing du rang shar shog /rang la tshig ngan zur tsam mi bzod kyang*/ gzhan dag khyad gsod gnod 'tshe sgrub pa la// nyams nga spu tsam med pa'i snying khams kyi// blo gdengs rgyud la 'byung ba med par shog /bla ma sangs rgyas nyid du ma mthong bas// rang la mnyes dang mi mnyes tshad bzung mkhan// blo rings mar khog snum gyis mi thul ltar// de 'dra'i dri ma nam yang mi 'byung shog /dam chos zab dgu'i rgya mtsho btungs gyur kyang*// chos dang rang rgyud tha dad ya bral bas// 'chi khar gdams ngag dpe la ma lus par// thos don rgyud la 'byor bas smin grol shog /rang sems chos kyi ma thul tha mal du// dug lnga'i rba klong drag por 'khrugs na yang*// gzhan la chos bshad dbang bskur byed rloms kyis// rang gzhan 99)be sbrel g.yang la mi mchong shog /bla ma'i byin rlabs slob ma'i mos gus dang*// khams dang bsam pa rgyud tshod shes pa sogs// rdul tsam med bzhin 'gro don ming btags pa'i// zang zing sdud pa'i g.yeng ba mi byed shog

/dben par sgrub la 'bad pa'i blo yod kyang*// mkha' khyab 'gro phan slad du rdzogs byang don// mi gnyer tshe 'di'i 'dod pa sna tshogs phyir// las mtha' phan gnod sgrub par mi byed shog /gal te phyogs med rgyal khams 'phyo na yang*// bdag 'dzin khong skran rtsad nas ma zhig par// phyi rol tho co bcos ma'i brtul zhugs kyis// sdom gsum sa la bskur bar mi byed shog /rang lus tsher mas zug pa'ang mi bzod bzhin// kha lta stong pa'i rbad khams 'brug ldir bas// chos dang bla ma'i zhabs 'dren mi byed par// bag yod rgyu 'bras 100)rten 'brel lam lhongs shog /skyid sdug gang byung blam dkon mchog gi /thugs rjer ma shes rkyen ngan cung zad la'ang*// khyi rgan lag pa chag pa'i 'o dod ltar// mi 'bod sdug bsngal ro snyoms nus par shog /phan byed lha dang gnod byed 'dre zhes pa// kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i ngo la snang mod kyang*// rang rig chos nyid dbyings la bden dngos med// sgom chen 'khrul rjes 'breng bar mi byed shog /gsang sngags nye lam chos kun snying po'i snying*// bum dbang thob pas snod bcud dkyil 'khor shar// gsang dbang 'byung 'jug bzlas brjod mtha' dag sngags// sher dbang rtog tshogs lhan skyes bde grol shog /theg pa'i rtse rgyal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam// tshig dbang rin chen rig pa'i rtsal dbang don// bsgom du med la yengs pa skad cig bral// bzo med lhug pa'i bsam gtan gdengs thob shog /chos nyid mngon sum rang zhal 101)rjen par mthong*// nyams snang gong 'phel sa bcu lam lnga 'grod// rig pa tshad phebs longs sku'i zhing khams zin// chos can chos nyid klong du zad par shog /de mthus 'khrul pa'i yul dang yul can gyi// spros pa'i mtshan gzhi dngos paro mi gnas kyang*// smon lam thugs rje mthun pa'i rten 'brel gyis// gzhan don nam mkha'i mkha' mnyam 'byung bar shog

/drin can bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje'i mthu// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung nus pa'i stobs/ don dam chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag gi smon lam 'di bzhin 'grub par shog ces pa 'di ni rnam 'byor pa ā yu pū tra zhes bas nye bar bskul ngor bkod pa dge'o// oṃ swasti/ mtha' yas zhing khams rgya mtsho'i sangs rgyas dang*// legs gsungs bden gnyis zung 'jug dam pa'i chos/ de 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun tshogs bcas kyi// chos nyid 102) bden pas deng 'dir bde legs stsol// bka' rgyud bla ma rgyal ba dkyil 'khor lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung mthu stobs bdag /dkar skyong gzhi bdag lha klur bcas kun gyis// byin rlabs dngos grub phrin las char rgyun phob// phyogs bcu nam mkha' gar khyab 'jig rten kun// bde dge bkra shis 'byor pas gang bar shog /mi dge nyer 'tshe'i mtshan ma ji snyed dag /gang du nam yang 'byung ba med par shog /rgyal bstan dri med mdo sngags lung rtogs kyi// nyi zla gdul bya'i yid mkhar gsal bar shog /bstan 'gro'i sgrol ma skyes chen dam pa rnams// sku tshe phrin las chos 'byor 'phel bar shog /bshad sgrub bstan pa 'dzin pa'i 'dus sde kun// thugs mthun thos bsam sgom pas dus 'da' shog /ma rungs bdud kyi sprul pa'i mthu stobs kun// dkon mchog bden pa'i stobs kyis thul bar shog /'byung po'i kha rlangs nad yams 'khrug rtsod 103)dang*// sad ser phyugs nad mu ge kun zhi shog /'byung ba g.yo 'khrug gnod 'tshe mi 'byung zhing*// skye 'gro bde skyid dam chos spyod par shog /rgyal bas lung bstan dpal gyi shān+ti'i gnas// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mi nus rtag brtan shog /'gro pa'i gtsug rgyan mchog gi sprul pa'i sku// zhabs pad bskal brgya'i bar du brtan par shog /de yi bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i slob 'bangs rnams// dam tshig gtsang zhing chos spyod gong 'phel shog
