/sbyin bdag rnams kyang bstan la gus byed cing*// bar chad med par bsam don 'grub par shog /bdag sogs skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs kun// bstan 'gro'i phan bde stsol ba'i nor bur shog /rang don zhi bde log 'tsho mi sgrub par// rgyal ba'i phrin las rlabs chen spyod par shog /lhag bsam dag pas 104)smon lam 'di btab mthus// 'gro kun bla med rdzogs byang thob par shog/ maṅga laṃ// 'di ni gu ru rin po che'i lung bstan bzhin bod khams bde ba'i rten 'brel du dar gyi ri bor dar 'phan la bden tshig smon lam du bstar ba'o// 'di dang mtshungs pa gnas chen dpal gyi tsā ri tra'i sa gnad kyi snying po rnams su yang bden stobs kyi dar 'phan dang mtsho mchod kyi nang du shin tu mang bar bris kyang bshu bar ma nus so// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs kyi bdag /mnyam med bla ma mchog gi zhabs pad la// 'di bzung mthar thug byang chub snying po'i bar// skyabs su snying nas mchi zhing gsol ba 'debs// dmigs med thugs rje'i spyan gyis rtag gzigs nas// skye ba 'di bzung tshe rabs thams cad du// mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis legs brgyan pa'i// rten bzang thob nas bstan la 'jug pa dang*// bla ma mtshan ldan gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i bcud// bdag gi bskal ba'i bsod nams legs 'dzom ste/ 105)/nyams len brtson pa'i mthu dang byin rlabs stobs// rmad byung tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub gyur cig /sku gsum go 'phang mchog mthar phyin nas kyang*// bsam yas phrin las rgya mtsho'i zlos gar gyis/ mkha' khyab 'gro la gang 'dul 'dod ster 'phrul// 'khor ba'i mtha' mnyam nyid du 'byung bar shog /bla ma rgyal ba rgya mtsho sprul 'khor bcas// thugs rje'i nus pas bdag gi smon lam kun// gegs med myur 'grub bar chad kun zhi zhing*// chos dang bkra shis dge legs 'phel bar shog/ skal ldan rat+na bha dra'i mtshan 'chang bas// bka' bstsal dgongs bzhed bskang phyir 'di phul bar// khyed thugs dgyes nus bdag 'dras mi shes kyang*// rab dkar lhag bsam rten 'brel bzang bar 'khums// gang khyed mtshungs bral rgyal mchog de lta bu'i// zhabs pad spyi bor bsten pa'i skal bzang de// stong gsum nor bus bkang thob do zla

106) min// ci mdzad legs mthong ci gsungs bka' bsgrub pas// dam tshig gtsang ma rang sems dpang gzug gis// mi tshe legs par 'khyol ba'i zhabs gtog mdzod// khyed kyi gtan 'dun de kas 'grub pa lags// de las gzhan pa'i 'phral phugs 'di dang 'di'i// brtag gsal lung bstan 'bul rgyu bdag la med// dus gsum sgrib med mkhyen gzigs der bzhag nas// bas mtha'i rmongs rgan bdag 'drar ci zhig 'dri/ zhes byin rlabs dam rdzas bdud rtsi sman grub khungs btsun thum bu la rgya zhus phul ba la rtsis bzhes zhu zhing*/ kha thags gnang ba 'di dar cog tu bgyis yod pa yang*/ dbyings bzhugs 'tshal/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco lnga dge bar/ mtha' 'khob kyi mtshams mal nas phul ba dge// 'khor 'das lam gsum dge ba'i tshogs// bdag gis bsags dang gsog 'gyur ba'i// dug med bsngo pa'i rgyur gyur kun// sems can sangs rgyas thob rgyur bsngo// skyon bral yon tan mchog mnga' ba'i// bla ma yid bzhin nor bu nyid// 'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar/ 107)/'brel med gtsug tu bsten par shog /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kun gyi// snying po'i yang zhun phyag rgya che// thabs shes zung 'jug nyams len la// brtson pas 'bras bu mngon gyur shog /rten 'brel rgyu 'bras dam tshig sdom// nyes med phun tshogs mthar phyin zhing*// chos phyir dka' bzod rgyud smin grol// sa lam yon tan yongs rdzogs shog /log lam bdud kyis mi bskyod cing*// bla ma'i byin gyis rtag rlobs pa'i// skal pa bzang por bdag gyur nas// 'gro ba'i don rnams 'grub par shog ces pa'i smon lam 'di yang ye shes rab gsal la'o// gang la brten na thugs rje mchog mnga' ba'i*// skyabs gnas dkon mchog kun 'dus bla ma rje// sprul dang yang sprul bcas pa'i bden stobs kyis// smon lam gegs med 'grub par mdzad du gsol/

108)/deng bzung skye ba'i phreng ba ji snyed par// mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan dal 'byor lus// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan dang rim gnyis kyi// gtsug rgyan mngon par mtho bas 'byor gyur cig /mang thos khengs sems bral bas dus ldan dang*// legs bsam dri ma med pa'i blo gros ldan// don sgoms rgyud la 'byor ba'i nyams rtogs bcas// shes rab gsum gyis chos mig thob gyur cig zhen med log 'tsho bral ba'i 'byor pas phyug /gtong la yang dag goms pas tshogs chen rdzogs// rang 'dod mngon rlom spangs pa'i gzhan phan gyis// sems dpa' mchog gi rnam thar 'grub gyur cig /skyabs kun ngo bo gcig 'dus bla ma la// kha zhe tha dad min pa'i mos gus kyis// lus srog longs spyod ltos med zhabs tog dang*// sgrub pas mnyes pa mtha' ru phyin gyur cig 109)/dam pa'i chos dang 'gal ba'i bar chad tshogs// yul dus gnas skabs gang du'ang mi 'byung zhing*// rnam dkar dge ba'i mthun rkyen ji snyed kun// srid zhi'i khyon mnyam 'bad med 'byung gyur cig /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba byang chub lam// ma 'khod de srid rje btsun bla ma yi// sku gsung thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul rmad byung gi /thugs rje'i zlos gar rgyun chad med gyur cig /nam mkha'i mtha' khyab 'gro ba'i khams rgya mtsho// ma zad de srid bdag gi lhag bsam gyi// smon lam nus pa'i phrin las mi zad pas// sems can thams cad sangs rgyas sar 'god shog /dus gsum bde gshegs bla ma yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos srung byin rlabs nus mthu dang*// chos nyid don dam bden pa'i stobs chen pos// smon lam thog pa med 'grub bkra shis shog ces pa 'di ni rigs rus 'byor pa'i dpal gyi mngon par mtho ba las kyang dam pa'i chos la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang mi mnyam 110) pa'i brtson pa can/ yang dag pa'i yon tan nges par legs pa'i dpal gyis phyug par gyur pa/

shar spu bo ka nam nas sku mdun dbon mo'i drung gi bka' bskul pa bzhin chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mo'i sgom khang du bris te phul ba // rgyal kun ye shes thugs rje gcig bzlums pa// pad 'byung 'dzam gling grags dang rat+na'i zhabs// 'ja' tshon bzang po rdo rje legs grub rtsal/ skyabs gnas bslu med thugs rje nus mthu yis// 'di bzung skye ba'i lug rgyud ji snyed par// chos kun snying po phyag rgya chen po dang*// dam chos 'dul ba'i kun spyod zung 'jug nyid// rang blo'i tha rgod 'dul sbyong thog tu khel// lta spyod rnam dag 'brel bas bstan srog zin// smon lam byang sems nus pas 'gro don 'grub// dri med rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs chen la// rang gzhan bde blag 'khor pa nyid gyur cig ces pa 'di ni rgyal sras rig pa 'dzin pa chen 111) po chos dbyings klong grol gyi bzhed pa ltar bris pa'o// pra ṇi dhā na sid+dhan+tu/ gdod ma'i gzhi la 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi// dmigs mtshan bral yang kun brtags 'khrul blo yi// snang ngor lam gyi chos tshul ji snyed pa'i// smon lam btab 'di don du 'gyur bar shog /rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab snying po kun// sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du nyer gnas pa// mngon du 'gyur byed thabs mang rgya che ba'i// gnad don ma nor lam du lhongs par shog /khams drug ldan pa'i dal 'byor rin chen lus// rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yi rten gnas la// rlung dang thig le'i 'du 'god spro bsdu yis// rnam smin ma dag phung po dag byed shog /brda yi gtum mo a shad rab 'bar ba// don gyi gtum mo bde gsal mi rtog pa// rtags kyi gtum mo sher phyin rnal 'byor ma// dbyer med las 112)nyon bag chags bsreg nus shog /'khor 'das mtha' dag sgyu ma'i rol pa la// rtag brtan bden par bzung ba'i zhen blo 'dis// thog med da bar 'khrul pa'i rgyu rkyen byas// da nas cir snang sgyu mar shar grol shog

/'byung ba las grub snod kyi 'jig rten dang*// khams lngas bskyed pa'i bcud kyi skye 'gro sogs// bdag gzhan ma dag sgyu ma'i dngos 'dzin kun// dag pas ye shes sgyu mar rang grol shog /tshogs drug sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs la// chags sdang spong len byis pa'i rtsed mo ltar// mi bden bden par 'dzin 'di zhig nas kyang*// ma dag sgyu lus 'ching ba kun grol shog /gzugs snang lha dang grags pa'i sgra rnams sngags// dran rtog ye shes 'khor lor lhun grub pas// dngos dang dngos min mtha' las yongs grol ba'i// dag pa'i sgyu lus brtan pa thob par shog /longs spyod 'khor lor las rlung cho 'phrul 113)gyi// 'khrul 'khor cir yang shar la rmi lam zhes// nying 'khrul de la bzang ngan rtags bzung ba'i// col chung byis pa'i rnam thar mi ston shog /mi tshe'i phyed ni gti mug gnyid dbang 'gro// de la gdams pa'i gnad med 'khrul 'byams ngang*// dal 'byor stong zad gtong ba'i blo dred po// da nas gdams pa'i gnas la 'jug byed shog /rmi lam rmi lam du shes bzung gnad dang*// yi dam lhar sprul gcig las mang por bsgyur// zhing khams bgrod dang gdul bya'i don byed sogs// sprul bsgyur sbyong spel rang dbang thob par shog /gnyid kyi rmi lam dbyings su nub pa dang*// rmi lam chen po 'di snang 'khrul pa zhi// dus mtha'i rmi lam bar do'i 'khrul rgyun chad// rmi lam rnam gsum 'khrul pa rtsad chod shog /gdod nas dag pa'i gnas lugs 'od 114)gsal che// 'jag mig srin bu yan gyi 'gro kun la// khyab kyang rang ngo ma shes lhan skyes kyi// mi shes dri ma dbyings su zhi bar shog /gzhi yi 'od gsal mngon du byas pa'i phyir// lam gyi 'od gsal sgrub pa'i thabs gdan la// rab brtson 'bras bu'i 'od gsal chos kyi sku// rang la bzhugs pa'i rang zhal mthong bar shog

/nyams kyi 'od gsal phra rags 'char sgo la// zhen rlom khengs sems chog par 'dzin spong zhing*// rtogs pa don gyi 'od gsal dri bral nyid// rang gsal rang rig chen por gdengs thob shog /rtags kyi 'od gsal snang bzhi mthar phyin nas// brda yi 'od gsal dag pa rab 'byams shar// don gyi 'od gsal 'char nub spros dang bral// zung 'jug chen po'i klong du grol bar shog /thog ma'i gzhi nas mthar thug byang chub bar/ 115)/'khor 'das bar dor ma gyur 'ga' med kyang*// bar ma do zhes ngan par bzung ba'i blo// log par rtog pa'i mdud brgya gtan grol shog /skye shi bar dor rtag 'dzin zhen pa chod// rmi lam bar dor nying 'khrul mgo 'khor sangs// 'chi kha bar dor gnad gcod zug rngu bral// chos nyid 'od gsal gzhi la grol bar shog /goms stobs chung bas dus der ma grol kyang*// rang snang sgra 'od zer la mi skrag par// zhi khro'i lha dang de yang rang rig gi /rang rtsal ye shes yin par rtogs grol shog /gal te bag chags tshan che shugs drag pas// srid pa las kyi bar do 'char ba na// ma nges rtags drug sgra bzhi g.yang sa gsum// kun grol skye 'jug rang dbang thob par shog /gang zhig tshe 'dir g.yeng ba'i dbang song nas// zab don nyams len nus stobs dang 116)bral na// sdig can gsang lam btsan thabs bgrod nus pa'i// zab lam 'pho ba'i rten 'brel 'dzom par shog /'pho bya 'pho byed bral ba chos sku'i lam// bskyed rim lha skur grol ba longs sku'i gnas// yul dang yul can sprad pa sprul sku'i thabs// gang la goms pa'i nyams len don 'grub shog /mtshan ldan bla ma dad can slob ma gnyis// dam tshig sel med mos gus mtshams sbyar te// byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba la sogs pas// 'chugs med mkha' spyod gnas su 'pho nus shog /rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams rigs lnga'am// bde can dga' ldan pad+ma 'od la sogs// dag pa'i zhing du sa lam mthar phyin te// sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren la mnga' brnyes shog
/de ltar smon lam btabs pa'i dge 'bras mthus// tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang dbang bzhis rgyud smin cing*/ 117)/rim gnyis lam bzang grol ba mthar phyin te// sku gnyis go 'phang thob nas 'gro grol shog/

ces gsang sngags kyi myur lam phal mo che rnams kyi gnad gsang snying po ni gsar ma'i chos drug gam/ rnying ma'i bar do khrid drug tu ma 'dus pa cher med pas de dang mthun pa'i smon lam nyams len gyi rtsa tshig lta bur 'gyur ba'i gnad 'dus shig dgos zhes yon tan dbang phyug gi ring nas bskul rung*/ don 'di dag gi chos thams cad kyi sgrom dang byings che ba yin pa'i gnad kyi/ tshig nyung ngur bsdus tshe gang zag phal gyis go bar dka' ba tsam du gyur na'ang*/ bskal ba rab kyi snod ldan dag la sgrogs 'phrol byed dang*/ thun mong ba dag la smon lam bden tshig tu 'gyur ba'i dge ba la dmigs nas bkod pa dge'o// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i zlos gar ni// chos dbyings yangs pa'i 'khor yug kun 'gengs pa'i// rnam 'dren sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul ji snyed dbus// nges gsang a ti'i snying po rdo rje'i dbyangs// mngon par 118)sgrog la gdong lnga'i sgra gzhom mkhan// chos brgyad 'khor lo'i srog shing rming med du// gtong la bsgrun bral dpa' bo gcig pu nyid// skal bzang dad pa rgya mcho'i mgon bzhugs gsol// sna tshogs 'khrul pa'i 'du 'god 'bum phrag gis// rang gzhan gtan 'dun hrul por byed pa la// 'gro don zhes pa'i mtshan snyan gser sgrog gi// ma bcings nges don sgron mar zhabs brtan gsol// dbu ba rdol 'dra'i zang zing sgyu ma'i nor// 'tshol sgrub gsog 'jog 'gyed la bus pa'i gar// gang la gdul bya'i ming gi g.yo thabs brgya'i// phrin las brdzus ma'i ma sgribs zhabs brtan gsol// ro 'dzin glog ltar g.yo bskyod ngal spangs kyang*/ gnas lugs ye shes rtogs la mi nye bar// 'dab chags smra mkhan ji lta'i 'chad nyan gyi// khur pos mi bsnyel sgrub brtson 119)brtan bzhugs gsol/ snyigs mtha'i 'gro ba chos kyi gdul slad dang*// de yang spros pa'i 'khor los ma yin phyir// mgon khyod gong ma'i rnam thar rjes 'gro ba'i// sgrub rgyud phrin las skyong zhing zhabs brtan gsol// chos kun snying po'i gnas lugs a ti'i gshis// bcos min gdod ma'i kun bzang khyed thugs dang*// dbyer med 'gyur ba bral ba'i thugs rje'i rtsal// phyogs mthar 'gyed pa'i phrin las gong 'phel shog

ces pa'i brtan bzhugs 'di ni/ 'khrul zhig lha btsun chen po'i sprul pa'i sku'i drung phul ba'o// skyabs gnas dkon mchog thugs rje nus stobs kun// gcig bsdus rigs bdag bla ma rje btsun mchog /rang sems spros med rang ngo sprod mdzad der// phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi smin grol dngos grub zhu// 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba sems nyid 'di// gdod nas yongs dag spros bral 120)chos kyi skur// lhun gyis grub kyang rang las rang bsgribs pa'i// ma rig lhan skyes dri ma dag par shog /'khrul pa gzhi la med kyang blo bur du// med bzhin snang bar mthong ba'i ra ri yis// thog med da bar 'khor bar 'ching ba 'di// sbrul mdud lta bur rang sar grol bar shog /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i dngos po ni// rdul phran tsam yang sems la ma grub kyang*// chos dang gang zag bdag tu bzung zhing 'dzin// bdag med tshig tsam ma yin rtogs par shog /chos lugs grub mtha' nga bzang zhen phyogs la// ye nas goms bzhin grogs kyis chags sdang slob// kun slong sran du 'dril ba'i rtsod gzhi yis// rang dang gzhan rgyud bsreg par mi byed shog /'gro ba'i khams rgyud tha dad mang po la// dgongs nas rgyal bas chos sgo mang bstan yang*/ mthar thug gdod 121)ma'i gnas lugs rtogs thabs su// gcig pa'i chos kyi snying po lon par shog /lta ba'i bzhed srol rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang*// rang rig rjen pa'i rang ngo ma mthong na// tshig dang khas len lta ba ci bzang yang*// grol min lta don rgyud la 'char bar shog /sgom par btags kyang sgom rgyu'i dngos pos dben// sgom mkhan rang ngo rig na sgom pa'i mchog /bsgom dang mi bsgom res 'jog ma yin par// sgom med yengs bral mngon du 'gyur bar shog /zhi bar gnas la bzang po 'dzin blo dang*// yengs su dogs pa'i dran pa bcos ma yis// sems kyis sems nyid btson du mi 'ching bar// gang shar rang ngo rig la goms thob shog

/bde gsal mi rtog nyams la dga' brod dang*// 'gyu rtog skyon du bzung nas spong 'dod kyi// dgag sgrub gnyis 'dzin lhan pa mi 122)'debs par*// ji ltar 'char ba sgom du 'khyer nus shog /dben par rkyen med bde bar gnas pa'i tshe// bzang bzang 'dra ba'i sgom nyams bzo bde po// yul rkyen drag por phrad na rang 'tshang ston// de lta'i sgom gyis bsdu bar mi 'gyur shog /gnas par snang ba sems kyi 'dug tshul dang*// 'phro bar snang yang 'gag med rol rtsal te// gang la'ang dgag sgrub bcos bsgyur mi byed par// rang babs lhug pa rig thog rang grol shog /go ba nyams myong rtogs pa'i bye brag sogs// dbang rim brtson 'grus dang mthun 'char tshul la// ra gan gser du 'dzin blos mi 'ching bar// yin lugs gnas don ji bzhin rtogs par shog /ngar 'dzin mdud pa nang nas ma grol bar// tho ca smyon spyod bcos ma'i brtul zhugs kyis// sdom gsum rlung la bskur ba'i 'khrul zhig tu// mi byed lta spyod phyi nang 123)mthun par shog /tshig zur mtho dman tsam yang mi thegs bzhin// ro snyoms gsob tu zhugs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren mi byed par// stong nyid rgyu 'bras zung 'jug shes par shog /rtsa rlung khams sems dwangs cha'i yon tan tsam// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul phra mo'i lam rtags la// rang gzhan gnyis kas grub thob mtshan gsol te// lha bu'i bdud kyi mnga' thang mi bskyed shog /sku gsum 'bras bu gzhi la ye rdzogs kyi// yon tan bri gang med par ma rtogs pas// sa lam nyams rtogs re bas mi bsgug cing*// 'bras bu gzhan nas 'tshol bar mi byed shog /sems skyed smon lam tshogs gnyis mtshams sbyor dang*// rim gnyis mngon gyur nus stobs byin rlabs mthus// ris med rlabs chen 'gro don shugs 'byung mas// ltar snang rnyed tshol 'gro

124)don mi sgrub shog /de ltar gnas skabs 'dod don ma yin pa'i// mthar thug yang dag don gyi smon tshig 'di// ji ltar btabs bzhin gegs med myur 'grub par// skyabs mchog bla ma rnams kyis mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa 'di ni/ bo dongs thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis blo'i pad+mo kha phyes pa'i ston sgom nges don chos rgyal gyi bzhed dgongs ltar bris pa'o// sangs rgyas thams cad don la ngo bo gcig /gnas skabs gdul bya'i snang ngor tha dad tshul// kun kyang ye shes 'khor lor ro cig pa'i// spyi gzugs gangs can mgon po spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje thabs mkhas 'gro la rtag tu brtse// khams gsum rigs drug kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// mtshan tsam dran pas las nyon sdig sgrib sbyong*// gsol ba btab pas yid la 'dod dgu stsol// lha dang bla ma dbyer med thugs rje'i bdag /khyed sku dran cing mos pas bsgoms pa dang*// gsung 125)mchog yig drug rdo rje'i bzlas pa yis// khyod thugs 'od gsal chos sku mngon 'gyur shog /nam mkhas gar khyab 'gro ba rigs drug kun// thog ma med nas bdag gi pha dang ma// drin lan ma 'khor chags sdang gnod 'tshe bsgrubs// da nas drin lan chos kyis 'khor byed shog /'di nas bzung ste tshe rabs nam du yang*// 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyis rjes bzung ste// byams dang snying rje phyogs ris med pa yis// sems can thams cad bde la 'god par shog /gzungs sngags rgyal po yi ge drug pa 'di// sangs rgyas kun gyis thugs srog snying po ste// bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i byin rlabs rmad byung bas// bar chad kun zhi dngos grub mchog thob shog /'phags mchog khyed kyi phrin las nus stobs dang*// mtshungs pa'i yon tan ma lus bdag 'grub nas// gang la gang 'dul 126)phan bde'i phrin las kyis// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem byed shog

/lhag bsam rnam dag byang chub sems kyi rgyun// nam yang nyams pa med pa'i 'gro ba'i don// rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyis mdzad pa dang*// rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa bdag 'grub shog /mdor na bdag dang pha ma mkha' mnyam gyi// 'gro kun thugs rje chen po myur 'grub nas// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po yi// go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob gyur cig ces pa 'di ni/ dad ldan karma tshe ring la'o/ / swasti pra dzñā bh+ya: gang zhig rgyal ba'i thugs rje ni// bsam mi khyab pa'i zlos gar las// sna tshogs tshul gyi sna tshogs pa'i// gdul bya 'dul mdzad la phyag 'tshal// bskal bzang 'dren pa stong dag gi /zhabs 'bring brgya byin lha yi dbang*// mos pas rin chen g.yas 'khyil dung*// rgyal la phul zhing byin gyis brlabs/ 127) /gang gi thugs rje rmad byung gi /rten 'brel nus stobs mthu chen pos// chos kyi dung chen bla med sgras// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nyid gyur cig /phyogs bcu mtha' yas zhing kun tu// chos dung rdo rje'i dbyangs chen pos// yongs khyab mchod pa'i phul dang rab// bstod dbyangs rgyun mi chad du shog /gzhom med rdo rje'i dbyangs chen 'dis// ma rungs bdud tshogs tshar gcod cing*// tshogs mchog dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde// thos bsam sgom bstan rab rgyas shog /chos dung dbyangs sgra thos pa'i 'gro// khams gsum sa kun sdig sdug dang*// ngan 'gro'i rgyu rkyen rgyun chod pa'i// phrin las mchog tu 'gyur bar shog /rgyal dang rgyas sras thugs rje dang*// 'phags mchog 'dus sde'i byin rlabs kyis// phyogs dus kun tu bstan 'gro'i don// dge legs yongs 128)khyab bkra shis shog ces pa 'di ni smin grol bskyed rdzogs gling gi tshogs dung la rin chen gyi gshog pa phul ba'i skabs su dar gyi cod pan la smon lam 'di nyid bris te phul pa'o/ ༈ oṃ sarba maṅga la swasti hūm̐/

phyogs bcu rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing kun na// mkhyen brtse nus pa rgya mtsho'i gter mnga' ba'i// sangs rgyas sras 'khor rgya mtsho'i sprin phung gis// thugs rje byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i char chen phob// rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kyi// gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod// mtha' dag rdzu 'phrul bkod pa'i sku gcig tu// legs sprul mtsho skyes rdo rje'i byin rlabs shing*// bslu med skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog dang*// gang gi sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul yi dam lha// phrin las drag rtsal dbang bsgyur bstan srung gi /chos skyong tshogs kyis mchog thun dngos grub stsol// ris med phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten 129)khams kun dang*// grangs med 'gro ba'i spyod yul dus gsum du// mi dge nyer 'tshe'i mtshan mas dben pa dang*// rtag tu bde dge 'byor pas 'tsho gyur cig /rgyal ba'i rgyal mchog shākya'i dbang po yi// bstan pa mdo sngags nyi zla zung gcig 'di/ nam yang 'grib med thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyun// grub mtha' phyogs lhung bral bar 'phel gyur cig /theg pa'i yang rtse bstan pa kun gyi bcud// 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bstan mchog gang*// 'dzin skyong spel mdzad rnam 'dren 'dus sder bcas// 'bral med smin grol dga' ston spyod gyur cig /ma rung log par 'dren pa'i bar chad bgegs// chos min 'jig rten chos brgyad chags sdang gis// nyer bskyed log pa'i spyod ngan bstan pa'i srol// mtha' dag nam yang 'byung ba med gyur cig /rnam 130)'dren mchog rnams sku tshe phrin las 'phel// dge 'dun mthun rgyas bslab gsum dri med spyod// sbyin pa'i bdag rnams yid la gang bsam 'grub// thams cad byang chub snying por grol gyur cig /rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs rje dang*// bdag sogs 'khor 'das lam gsum dge tshogs mthus// smon lam dge legs rgya mtsho'i bkra shis char// srid zhi 'khor 'das yongs la khyab gyur cig

ces pa'i smon lam 'di nyid/ bla ma rig 'dzin ye shes pas lhag bsam gyi nye bar bskul ba bzhin/ gnas chen mgo dgu'i yang dben kun snang dang ba'i sgom khang gser gyi rgyal mtshan mngon par mtho ba'i mtshams khang du yi ger spel ba dge'o// mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan pa yi// dkon mchog rgyal ba sras bcas bla ma'i tshogs// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung gter bdag rnams// bdag gi smon lam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// skye ba 'di bzung mthar thug byang chub bar// mi 131)khom mi skye dal 'byor phun tshogs thob// dbang po tshang zhing dam chos spyod pa'i rigs// skal pa bzang po'i lus su skye bar shog /mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis brgyan bzhin du// 'khor bar mi chags nges 'byung bsam pas bskul// rgyal bstan dri ma med pa'i sgor zhugs nas// thar pa dam pa'i sa bon thebs byed shog /bstan pa'i gzhi ma so thar rigs bdun gyi// sdom pas legs bsdams nyes ltung dri ma bral// mi rtag sdug bsngal kun 'byung lam 'gog gis// bden bzhi'i spong len ma nor mngon gyur shog /nyan rang dman pa'i lam gyis mi 'ching bar/ theg chen rgyal sras lam bzang la zhugs pas// pha rol phyin bcu smon 'jug don dam gyi// byang chub sems don rlabs chen 'grub byed shog /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa'i lam ring la// grangs med gsum du ngal ba mi dgos par/ 132)/rdo rje'i theg pa 'bras bu'i nye lam la// the tshom mi 'jug 'gal rkyen mi 'byung shog /dag pa mtha' bzhi kṛ yas rgyud sbyangs shing*// lta spyod zung 'brel u pas gnyis 'dzin grol// mngon byang lnga ldan yo ga'i sa lam rdzogs// gsang sngags phyi rgyud nus pa mthar phyin shog /ma hā yo gas bskyed rim lus lhar 'grub// a nu yo gas rdzogs rim zab lam smin// a ti rdzogs chen chos sku'i rang zhal mthong*// yo ga gsum gyis tshe gcig sangs rgyas shog

khregs chod 'khor 'das phyag rgya chen por grol/ thod rgal sku dang zhing khams tshad la phebs// gcod yul dngos por 'dzin chen rtsad nas chod// lam 'bras zag med 'od skur grol bar shog /gtum mo'i rtsal rdzogs sgyu lus tshad du 'byongs// rmi lam dbyings thim 'od gsal mngon du gyur// bar do ngos 133)zin 'pho bas lam mchog bgrod// zab lam chos drug rgyud la 'khel bar shog /sor sdud bsam gtan sprul sku'i sa bon thebs// srog dang rtsol bas longs sku'i yon tan 'grub// rjes dran ting 'dzin chos sku mthar phyin pas// sbyor ba yan lag drug gis rgyud grol shog /rnam rtog ngos zin nyon mongs lam du lhongs// na tsha grogs shar 'jigs skrag rang mtshang rig /sdug bsngal dbyings thim 'chi ba chos skur grol// ro snyoms drug la brtan pa thob par shog /mdor na rgyal gsu+ung chos sgo rab 'byams kyi// don kun legs grub sa lam yon tan rdzogs// rang don 'gyur med btsan sa zin nas kyang*// gzhan don nam mkha' mnyam pa 'grub gyur cig

ces/ byang chub lam rim mdo sngags thams cad tshang ba'i smon lam ngag 'don du bgyid chog pa dgos zhes/ dbon po bstan pa'i ming can gyis bskul ngor bris pa'o// bskal bzang 134)rgyal ba sras bcas las// snying stobs brtson 'grus phul byung ba// shākya seṅge shākya'i gtso// bkra shis byin rlabs char chen phob// shes rab mchog ldan shā ri'i bu// rgyal sras sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po// bram ze chen po rā hu la// bkra shis byin rlabs char chen phob// mgon po klu sgrub legs ldan 'byed// dpal sbas ye shes snying po dang*// gangs can bstan rtsa zhi ba 'tsho// bkra shis byin rlabs char chen phob// sba btsun rat+na g.yo dmar gtsang*// bla chen grum ston klu mes sogs// dbus gtsang mi bcu smad 'dul rgyud// bkra shis byin rlabs char chen phob// sgra gcan 'dzin slob zag zad sde// chos sde dharma pā la'i zhabs// pradzñā pā la stod 'dul rgyud// bkra shis byin rlabs char chen phob// klu sgrub yon blo rin chen bshes// chos bzang gu ṇa sā ga ra// chos kyi 'phreng ba zhi 135)'byung sbas// bkra shis byin rlabs char chen phob// paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra// byang rdor rnam gnyis dbang phyug grags// gzhon nu byang chub yon rgyal ba// bkra shis byin rlabs char chen phob// yon tan blo gros seṅge dpal// rab 'byor seṅge chos grub song*// dbyangs can bzang po dkon mchog 'bangs// bkra shis byin rlabs char chen phob// dbang phyug rdo rje dga' ba'i dbyangs// rang grol rje sogs 'dul sdom gyi// bla rgyud rin chen tshar dngar bas// bkra shis byin rlabs char chen phob// bstan pa'i gzhi ma so so thar// bslab gsum yid bzhin nor bu yis// rang gzhan dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i// bkra shis byin rlabs char chen phob// 'dul sdom dri med nyi 'od kyis// bstan pa'i pad tshal cher rgyas shing*// 'dul

136)bya'i rkang drug tshim byed pa'i/ bkra shis phyog mthar khyab rgyas shog ces so thar gyi sdom pa'i mkhan rgyud snga phyi bar gsum la brten pa'i shis pa brjod pa 'di lta bu zhig gyis shig ces/ mnyam med mchog gi sprul pa'i sku bzang po'i mtshan can gang gi bka' stsal spyi bor blangs nas yig lam du bkod par bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// chos dbyings gdod ma'i klong las thugs rje'i sku// kun bzang snang mtha' rdor 'chang rdo rje sems// spyan ras gzigs dbang la sogs lha yi lha// rgyal ba dgongs rgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /chos sku'i rang mdangs gsal stong sgyu ma'i sku'i// dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī sing bi ma la// pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs sprul pa'i sku// rig 'dzin brda rgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /lha lcam mtsho rgyal rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang*// gter ston sprul pa'i skyes mchog rim brgyud pa// gsar rnying bshad sgrub bstan 137)pa 'dzin mdzad pa'i// gang zag snyan rgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /byams chen ngang las snying rjes khro tshul gyis// gang 'dul phrin las rol gar ston pa'i lha// dbang drag 'bar ba la sogs dkyil 'khor gyi// lha tshogs yi dam rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /don dam dbyings la spros mtshan mi dmigs kyang*// ye shes sgyu 'phrul rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston// seng gdong ma sogs mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang*// chos skyong dam can srung ma'i bkra shis shog /skyabs gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong dkar phyogs gzhi bdag thams cad kyi// thugs rje byin rlabs dngos grub bkra shis char// phyogs dus kun tu rgyun chad med 'bab shog ces pa 'di yang rgya bod mtshams nas shar phyogs la mo rtse'i bla mas bskul ba bzhin bkod pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ dge'o// 138)
